title: Aegidron
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 60% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)
flavor: |In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron's wings was used to send simple flash signals.
intro: Aegidron (Japanese: シェルガドラ Shelgadra) is a Dragon/Ground element Pal.

title: Amione
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.
intro: Amione (Japanese: リオリネ Riorine) is a Water-element Pal. Amione is a pair of Pals resembling vaguely-humanoid sea angels. They have eyes on the front of their head, but their mouths are on the top and split open when they eat. Both appear to wear dresses and have hair with buns and loops, but they each have a different colour; The left Amione has orange accents while the right has blue. Amione almost always hold hands in their animations.

title: Anubis
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, applies Ground damage to the player's attacks. Sometimes dodges attacks with a high speed sidestep while in battle.
flavor: |Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this pal became a token of death.
intro: Anubis (Japanese: アヌビス Anubis) is a Ground-element Pal. Anubis is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with dog-like features. It has a predominantly light-brown body with dark-brown hair that resembles a veil, a golden circle on its forehead, blue highlights in its ears and an intricate golden pattern with blue highlights near the end of its hair. Anubis also wears dark brown pants with golden highlights, a golden usekh-style collar with blue highlights, and brown-and-gold armbands.

title: Arsox
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Cold Resistance +2. (Does not stack)
flavor: |In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.
intro: Arsox (Japanese: ブルフェルノ Bullferno) is a Fire-element Pal. Arsox is a medium-sized, goat-like Pal with a tan body and red fur on its back and on the sides of its head. It also has large, curved horns, grey metal bands around its ankles, and a fiery mane and tail.

title: Astegon
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores, and you can obtain more Ore while mounted.
flavor: |A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.
intro: Astegon (Japanese: ジオラーヴァ Jiorava) is a Dragon / Dark-element Pal. Astegon is a large, bipedal draconic Pal with a black armored body, large black wings with scarlet flames emanating from them, gem-like purple claws on its hands and feet, and a pinkish horn on its head.

alpha.name: Heat Resistant Refined Metal Armor Schematic 4

title: Astralym
flavor: |A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer. I never wanted to hurt anyone. I just wanted to be together, just wanted to be there. But because that was forbidden... because they wouldn't forgive us... I decided I wanted a world for just the two of us.
intro: Astralym (Japanese: ゼロヴァース Zeroverse), also known as the Calamity, is an elementless Pal. It is the final boss of the game under the command of Zenara. Astralym is a black and white draconic Pal with a serpentine body and six wings. It sports a black and blue starburst marking on the center of its torso surrounded by four glowing cyan orbs, and similar orbs are found in its wingtips. In its second form, Astralym's forehead, chest, wings, and tail glow in a gradient pattern from magenta to bright blue.

title: Azurmane
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Also allows dashing in the air and moving at high speed.
flavor: |Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.
intro: Azurmane (Japanese: オーマサンダ Ohmasanda) is an Electric-element Pal. Azurmane is a large, equine Pal with a predominantly azure blue body and black thunderbolt markings. It also has golden, thunderbolt-shaped protrusions on its hindquarters, golden hooves, a golden emblem on its chest, and a black "mask" on the top half of its head with a jagged golden horn. Azurmane also has a tail and mane mane of glowing blue energy.

title: Azurobe
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Water and increases Attack by .
flavor: |This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.
intro: Azurobe (Japanese: アズレーン Azurain) is a Water / Dragon-element Pal. Azurobe is a long serpentine pal with long white ribbons attached to its light blue body, a dark blue hair like protrusion on the back of its head and a bright pink orb near the end of its tail. Azurube also has an Ice / Dragon-element subspecies, Azurobe Cryst.

title: Azurobe Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by .
flavor: |This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.
intro: Azurobe Cryst (Japanese: アズルーナ Azuruna) is the Ice / Dragon-element subspecies of Azurobe. Azurobe Cryst is largely identical to the regular Azurobe, save for possessing a light grey body and ribbons, light blue hair, and a blue orb at the end of its tail.

title: Bakemi
partner_skill_desc: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.
intro: Bakemi (Japanese: ウラミィ Uramii) is a Dark element Pal.

title: Bastigor
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with an Ice-forged hammer.
flavor: |The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.
intro: Bastigor (ヒョウガオー Hyougaoh) is an Ice-element Pal. Bastigor is a humanoid, tiger-like Pal with a blue-and-white body, black claws, and a large mane of fluffy greyish hair. It also wears what appears to be a brown-and-white loincloth.

title: Beakon
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.
flavor: |Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.
intro: Beakon (Japanese: ライバード Raibird) is an Electric-element pal. Beakon is an avian Pal reminiscent of a hawk or an eagle. It has a predominantly yellow body with a white underbelly, a black stripe on its chest, a black "mask" covering the top half of its face, a black and white plume on its head, and white, brown, and black highlights on its wings.

title: Beakon Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by (5~20)%. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)
flavor: |Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.
intro: Beakon Cryst is highly aggressive and will attack the player on sight as soon as it notices them. It does not require provocation to engage and will immediately initiate combat upon detecting a nearby player. There is no Alpha PALNAME as an overworld boss.

title: Beegarde
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Elizabee's Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.
intro: Beegarde (Japanese: ビーナイト Beeknight) is a Grass-element Pal. Beegarde is a small, humanoid Pal with bee-like features. It has a predominantly black body with yellow stripes and a purple plume on its head. It also wears what appears to be a black dress and a large, fluffy white collar around its neck. Beegarde also has pair of butterfly-like wings on its back and it carries a spear in its right hand.

title: Bellanoir
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Ray.
intro: Bellanoir (Japanese: ベラノワール Bellanoir) is a Dark-element Pal. Bellanoir is a tall, semi-humanoid Pal whose body resembles a flowing black dress with a ring of red eye-like patterns along the waist and large, blueish-purple flames visible beneath the dress in place of legs. Its arms have fraying "sleeves" ending in three-fingered hands and its right eye is covered by its blue hair. Bellanoir also has an antler-like protrusion coming out of the left side of its forehead, which starts blue then shifts to light purple at the tip. Bellanoir also has a subspecies, Bellanoir Libero.

title: Bellanoir Libero
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Bloom.
flavor: |With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. she longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.
intro: Bellanoir Libero (Japanese: ベラルージュ Bellarouge) is the subspecies of Bellanoir. Bellanoir Libero is largely identical to the regular Bellanoir, save for it having pinkish-purple flames under its dress, pinkish-purple hair, and a pinkish-purple head protrusion.

title: BigFoxWolf
intro: This pal is currently in the data, but not the live game.

title: Blazamut
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.
intro: Blazamut (Japanese: ボルカイサーVolkaiser) is a Fire-element Pal. Blazamut is a large, quadrupedal Pal with a similar body plan to a gorilla. It has red skin and a large, fluffy grey mane with another tuft of fur on its tail. It has a small yellow nose horn and a pair of large horns that appear to be made of rock with veins of lava coursing through them. Its hands are also covered in this same lava rock. Blazamut also has a Fire / Dragon-element subspecies, Blazamut Ryu.

title: Blazamut Ryu
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.
intro: Blazamut Ryu (Japanese: ボルドラゴ Voldrago) is the Dragon / Fire-element subspecies of Blazamut. Blazamut Ryu is largely identical to the regular Blazamut, save for it having a purple body, a black nose horn, and purple lava streams running through its horns and fists.

title: Blazehowl
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Grass Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapons- it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burred to a crisp.
intro: Blazehowl (Japanese: ゴクエンオ Gokuen'o) is a Fire-elemental Pal. Blazehowl is a large, leonine Pal with a predominantly black body, red markings on its back and legs, and two large, goatlike horns on its head. It also has a pair of flaming wings, a large fiery mane, and a line of flames running down its back to the tips of its tail. Blazehowl also has a Fire / Dark-element subspecies, Blazehowl Noct.

title: Blazehowl Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.
intro: Blazehowl Noct (Japanese: シンエンオ Shin'en'o) is the Fire / Dark element subspecies of Blazehowl. Blazehowl Noct largely identical to the regular Blazehowl, save for it having purple markings on its back and legs, light purple horns, and bluish-purple flames on its mane and back.

title: Blue Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Blue Slime is a Water-element Monster. The Blue Slime is a small, amorphous blob of blue slime. The Blue Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Boltmane
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden.
flavor: |The more it moves, the more it heats up and the hair tips increasingly glow brighter. At its peak, it becomes so dazzling that you risk blindness if you stare at it directly.
intro: Boltmane resembles a lion, featuring black fur and grey claws. Its eyes are red, and it has a mane, tail, and gem pattern on its forehead, all ablaze with fire.

title: Braloha
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While at a base, shortens the time it takes Pals assigned to BreedFarm to produce eggs. (Effect does not stack.)
flavor: |Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.
intro: Braloha (Japanese: トコナッツ Tokonattsu) is a Grass / Ground element Pal. Braloha is a large, sauropod-like Pal with a tan body, a cream-colored underbelly and green markings on its forelegs. It also possesses a crest of leaves and orange petals on its head, a large orange and peach-colored flower flanked by more large leaves on its back, and two pairs of small leaves near the tip of its tail.

title: Bristla
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Grass Pals by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles when a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.
intro: Bristla (Japanese: イバラヒメ Ibarahime) is a Grass-element Pal. Bristla is a small, semi-humanoid Pal with plantlike features. It has an olive-green body, a collar of darker green leaves around its neck, and it wears what appears to be a dress made of thorny green vines. It also has bright red "hair" made of more thorny vines as well as three yellow stamens protruding from the top of its hair.

title: Broncherry
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the "scent of first love."
intro: Broncherry (Japanese: ラブラドン Raburadon) is a Grass-element Pal. Broncherry is a large, sauropod-like Pal with a predominantly green body and tan coloration on its face and the front of its neck. It also has six large, reddish flower petals around the base of its neck, more petals on its head and the back of its neck, and three pairs of leaf-like protrusions on its tail. Broncherry also has a Grass / Water-element subspecies, Broncherry Aqua.

title: Broncherry Aqua
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a (45~55)% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the "perfume of purity"
intro: Broncherry Aqua (Japanese: スプラドン Spladon) is the Grass / Water-element subspecies of Broncherry. Broncherry Aqua is largely identical to the regular Broncherry, save for it having a predominantly blue body with a pale blue neck and face, as well as dark blue coloration on its back. It also has yellow flower petals, a small azure gem on its head, and a teardrop-shaped azure gem on its chest.

title: Bulldosu
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)
flavor: |In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.
intro: Bulldosu (Japanese: ドスコイヌ Dosukoinu) is a Ground element Pal.

title: Bushi
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.
flavor: |Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.
intro: Bushi (Japanese: ツジギリ Tsujigiri) is a Fire-element Pal. Bushi is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with a light tan body. It wears a wide-brimmed circular hat with a small flame on top, a sarashi wrap on its midsection, black pants with dull yellow highlights, and a red cloak with orange flame decals. Bushi also carries a katana. Bushi also has a Fire / Dark-element subspecies, Bushi Noct.

title: Bushi Noct
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri. When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.
intro: Bushi Noct (Japanese: ヤミウチ Yamiuchi) is the Fire / Dark-element subspecies of Bushi. Bushi Noct is largely identical to the regular Bushi, save for the fact that it has light blue skin, a purple flame atop its hat, blue highlights on its pants, and a purple cloak with violet flame decals.

title: Caprity
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.
intro: Caprity (Japanese: ベリゴート Berrygoat) is a Grass-element Pal. Caprity is a medium-sized, goat-like Pal with very predominantly green fur and white fur on the lower half of its face and around its neck. It also has a pair of horns on its head. On Caprity's back is a large green shrub covered in bright red berries. Caprity also has a Dark-element subpecies, Caprity Noct.

title: Caprity Noct
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores Pal's Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.
intro: Caprity Noct (Japanese: ベノゴート Venogoat) is the Dark-element subspecies of Caprity. Caprity Noct is largely identical to the regular Caprity, save for the fact that its body is predominantly light purple with dark purple fur on its back, pinkish fur around its chest, and a dark purple shrub on its back.

title: Carnibora
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals Grass damage to enemies it touches. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.
intro: Carnibora (Japanese: カプリリス Kapuririsu) is a Grass element Pal.

title: Cattiva
partner_skill_desc: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |At a glance it appears confident, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.
intro: Cattiva (Japanese: ツッパニャン Tsuppanyan) is a Neutral-element Pal. Cattiva is a small, bipedal cat-like Pal with a predominantly pinkish body. It has tufts on its cheeks and forehead and a cream-colored belly. Cattiva also strikes a confident pose while holding its paws on its sides when idle.

title: Cave Bat
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Cave Bat is a Neutral-element Monster. The Cave Bat is a small blue bat with an oversized head and wings compared to its torso. The Cave Bat is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Cawgnito
partner_skill_desc: When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.
intro: Cawgnito (Japanese: マスクロウ Maskrow) is a Dark-element Pal. Cawgnito is a medium-sized, bird-like Pal with a crow-like appearance. It has a black upper body. a white lower body, yellow feet, and a white, mask-like face. It also wears a wide-brimmed black hat and a black cloak with a red interior.

title: Celaray
partner_skill_desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.
flavor: |Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.
intro: Celaray (Japanese: ルミカイト Lumikite) is a Water-element Pal. Celaray is a small, ray-like Pal with a light blue body and a pale blue underside. It also has white markings on the top of its fins, two small nubs resembling hands on under its head, yellow markings on its face, and a pair of blue antennae with yellow tips. Celeray also has a Water / Electric-element subspecies, Celaray Lux.

title: Celaray Lux
partner_skill_desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.
flavor: |Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celeray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.
intro: Celaray Lux (Japanese: エレカイト Elekite) is the Water / Electric-element subspecies of Celaray. Celaray Lux is largely identical to the regular Celaray, save for the fact that it has a black body with a white underside and yellow stripes on its back.

title: Celesdir
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Increases the player's auto recovery speed while mounted.
flavor: |Ancient texts refer to it as the "Beast of Salvation." The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.
intro: Celesdir (Japanese: セレスディア Celesdir) is a Neutral-element Pal. Celesdr is a medium-sized, deer-like Pal with a predominantly white body and grey legs. It also has long flowing hair, a pair of curved antlers, and two ribbon-like blue tails.

title: Celesdir Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for (40~80)% Attack increase. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.
intro: Celesdir Noct is a Dark-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Celesdir.

title: Chikipi
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to the ranch.
flavor: |Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.
intro: Chikipi (Japanese: タマコッコ Tamakokko) is a Neutral-element Pal. Chikipi is a small avian Pal that closely resembles a chicken. Its body is in the shape of an egg and it is largely pure white, save for the bright red wattle under its beak and the comb on top of its body. It has grey oval eyes with white pupils and its beak is yellow. Chikipi's feet are orange with two claws in the front and one at the back of the foot.

title: Chillet
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dragon while mounted.
flavor: |It can curl its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.
intro: Chillet (Japanese: オコチョ Okocho) is an Ice / Dragon-element Pal. Chillet is a large, Mustelidae-like Pal with a long body, two large ears, and four stubby legs. It is typically seen standing on its hind legs, though it assumes a quadrupedal stance when roaming around or when being ridden by the player. Chillet's body appears light blue on the top and white on the bottom, also bearing several dark blue highlights along its chest, ears, back fins, and tail. Chillet also has a Fire / Dragon-element subspecies, Chillet Ignis.

title: Chillet Ignis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.
flavor: |When curled up it spins so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, sparks fly!
intro: Chillet Ignis (Japanese: モモチョ Momocho) is the Fire / Dragon-element subspecies of Chillet. Chillet Ignis is largely identical to the regular Chillet, though its body is light pink and peach with light red highlights.

title: Cinnamoth
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog. While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.
intro: Cinnamoth (Japanese: パピテフ Papitefu) is a Grass-element Pal. Cinnamoth is a small, moth-like Pal with a primarily yellow body, white fluff around its neck, and orange-yellow wings with maroon and white stripes. It also has two antennae with maroon and white tips on its head.

title: Clovee
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.
intro: Clovee (Japanese: ポワワ Powawa) is a Grass / Neutral element Pal. Clovee is a small, round, rabbit-like Pal with white fur, a pair of floppy ears, and four small, rounded limbs. It has a green, jerboa-like tail tipped with a white pom. It has a simple smile between two black eyes with white pupils, and a pair of clover leaves on the top of its face.

title: Cremis
partner_skill_desc: While in team, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.
intro: Cremis (Japanese: ミルフィー Milffy) is a Neutral-element Pal. Cremis is a small, dog-like Pal with a predominantly white body, brown legs, and two yellow spots on its cheeks. Most of its body is also covered in thick white fluff.

title: Croajiro
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Croajiro channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne, the player's Attack is increased by .
flavor: |Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.
intro: Croajiro (Japanese: ブシガエル Bushigaeru) is a Water-element Pal. Croajiro is a small, frog-like Pal with a predominantly green body and a cream-colored belly. It also wears a light grey gi with a black belt and carries a stick in its right hand. Croajiro also has a Water / Dark element subspecies, Croajiro Noct.

title: Croajiro Noct
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Dark attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |The Croajiro who have fosaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.
intro: Croajiro Noct (Japanese: ドスガエル Dosugaeru) is the Water / Dark-element subspecies of Croajiro. Croajiro Noct is largely identical to the regular Croajiro, save for it having a predominantly blue body and carrying a knife instead of a stick.

title: Cryolinx
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Dragon Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.
intro: Cryolinx (Japanese: ツンドラー Tundrar) is an Ice element pal. Cryolinx is a large, vaguely-feline bipedal Pal with a predominantly light blue body, a cream colored belly, short legs, and large arms. It also has darker blue markings and spikes on its arms, legs, and back, as well as cobalt blue claws on its hands and feet. Cryolinx also has a Ground-element subspecies, Cryolinx Terra.

title: Cryolinx Terra
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.
intro: Cryolinx Terra (Japanese: グランドラー Groundrar ) is the Ground-element subspecies of Cryolinx. Cryolinx Terra is largely identical to the regular Cryolinx, save for it having a predominantly brown body, a white belly, and golden markings and spikes on its arms, legs, and back.

title: Daedream
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.
flavor: |It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.
intro: Daedream (Japanese: ネムラム Nemuram) is a Dark-element Pal. Daedream is a small, bipedal Pal with a sheep-like appearance. Its body is predominantly dark purple, with light purple highlights on its hands and feet as well as a collar of blue fur around its neck. Daedream also has two small blue horns and long, wispy, purple-magenta hair with starry patterns in it.

title: Dandilord
partner_skill_desc: When activated, the player's attacks increase Poison buildup by 2. While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care. After all, the World Tree knows everything. Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.
intro: Dandilord (Japanese: ノクサージュ Nocsage) is a Grass / Dark-element Pal.

title: Dark Mutant
flavor: |Some say a beam from a Dark Mutant that has perfected its technique can tear holes into other dimensions. It's even believed that certain species of Pals were born from such phenomena.
intro: It has a purple pattern on its head, two black horns, and purple horns above its eyes. It also has purple claws on both its hands and feet.

title: Dazemu
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Runs faster over sand.
flavor: |Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.
intro: Dazemu (Japanese: トリステップ Toristep) is a Ground element Pal. Dazemu is a medium-sized, avian Pal that resembles an ostrich or emu. It has a black and white body with fluffy white feathers around the base of its neck. Dazemu also wears a reddish-brown shawl with yellow highlights and a reddish-brown cap with a large crest of feathers.

title: Dazzi
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with lightning bolts.
flavor: |Often kind to lonely pals. However, the moment a pal mistakes this for actual companionship it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.
intro: Dazzi (Japanese: カミナラシ Kaminarashi) is an Electric-element Pal. Dazzi is a small, semi-humanoid Pal with a light purple body, a dark purple chest wrap, white hair, and a small purple horn. The lower half of its body is hidden inside a small white cloud. Dazzi also has a Dark / Electric-element subspecies, Dazzi Noct.

title: Dazzi Noct
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with dark lightning bolts.
flavor: |Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.
intro: Dazzi Noct (Japanese: ヤミナラシ Yaminarashi) is the Dark / Electric-element subspecies of Dazzi. Dazzi Noct is largely identical to the regular Dazzi, save for having a white body, a yellow chest wrap and horn, and a black cloud and hair.

title: Demon Eye
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Demon Eye is a Dark-element Monster. Demon Eye is a floating, detached eyeball with a blue gradient iris. The Demon Eye is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Depresso
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by . Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.
intro: Depresso (Japanese: ンダコアラ Ndakoara) is a Dark-element Pal. Depresso is a small, bipedal Pal with a vague bear-like appearance. It has a predominantly dark blue body with purple highlights on its ears and a small tuft of purple hair on its head. It also has a black collar-like marking around its neck and a bushy black tail.

title: Digtoise
partner_skill_desc: When activated, enters the Shell Spin state. Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by 800% .
flavor: |A walking contradiction, possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it. "Digtoise's Fable" is a popular children's tale.
intro: Digtoise (Japanese: ドリタス Dritoise) is a Ground-element Pal. Digtoise is a large, tortoise-like Pal with a predominantly brown body and an orange head with a jagged, armored appearance. Its shell is brown with a white rim and it has an orange hexagon on each of the seven scutes, with a steel-colored drill protruding from each hexagon.

title: Dinossom
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.
flavor: |A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase "step on a Dinossom's tail" has come to mean enraging someone.
intro: Dinossom (Japanese: アロアリュー Aroaryū) is a Grass / Dragon-element Pal. Dinossom is a large, bipedal dinosaur-like Pal with a similar body plan to Elphidran and Relaxaurus. It has a light green body with an olive green belly and a darker green tail, with red claws on its hands and feet. Dinossom also has a large red flower flanked by green leaves on its head. Dinossom also has an Electric / Dragon-element subspecies, Dinossom Lux.

title: Dinossom Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Enhances Electric attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase "struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt" has come to mean narrowly escaping death.
intro: Dinossom Lux (Japanese: ビリビリュー Biribiryū) is the Electric / Dragon-element subspecies of Dinossom. Dinossom Lux is largely identical to the regular Dinossom, save for having a yellow body with a white belly and brown tail, along with brownish leaves on its head.

title: Direhowl
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.
flavor: |Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.
intro: Direhowl (Japanese: ガウルフ Gaurufu) is a Neutral-element Pal. Direhowl is a medium-sized, lupine Pal. It has black fur on its head, ears, and most of the body and white fur on its face, legs, mane, and tail.

title: Dogen
partner_skill_desc: When activated, moves to the closest base. Cannot be used within dungeons, etc.
flavor: |Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.
intro: Dogen (Japanese: ワンフー Wanfoo) is a Neutral element Pal. Dogen is a medium-sized, humanoid canine Pal with predominantly white fur and dark grey fur on its head and around its neck. It wears a wide-brimmed, red kasa hat, flowing red sleeves, and red pants with a golden belt. Dogen also has long grey hair and a long grey tail that it uses to support itself while levitating.

title: Dragostrophe
flavor: |A silent beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.
intro: Dragostrophe is a large mainly black Dragon-like pal with red patches of fur on it's lower body and it's eyebrows.

title: Dualith
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.
flavor: |One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.
intro: Dualith (Japanese: ウゴクゾー Ugokuzō) is a Ground / Grass-element Pal. Dualith also has a Ground / Dark-element subspecies, Dualith Noct.

title: Dualith Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand.
flavor: |One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!
intro: Dualith Noct (Japanese:ノロウゾー Norouzō) is a Ground / Dark-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Dualith.

title: Dumud
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Ground Pals by 15% . Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.
intro: Dumud (Japanese: トドドドン Todododon) is a Ground / Water-element Pal. Dumud is a large, piscine Pal with a predominantly brown body and a tan face. It also has two stubby pectoral fins, a short tail fin, and a bright yellow dorsal fin. Dumud also has a subspecies, Dumud Gild.

title: Dumud Gild
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +100~200% . Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.
intro: Dumud Gild (Japanese: ゴルドドン Goldodon) is the subspecies of Dumud. Dumud Gild is largely identical to the regular Dumud, though its entire body is covered in a lustrous golden sheen. It has a predominantly darker-golden body with a lighter gold face and dorsal fin.

title: Dupin
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player. Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased. (Does not stack)
flavor: |A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.
intro: Dupin (Japanese: ラピエール Rapierre) is a Fire element Pal.

title: Dynamoff
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs. (Does not stack)
flavor: |With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.
intro: Dynamoff (Japanese: ダイナモフ Dynamoff) is an Electric element Pal.

title: Eidrolon
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase for each other Dragon or Dark Pal in your party.
flavor: |A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.
intro: Eidrolon (Japanese: レイバーン Reivern) is a Dragon / Dark element Pal.

title: Eidrolon Ignis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increases by (2~6)% for each other Dragon or Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)
flavor: |A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.
intro: (Japanese: ヘルバーン Hellvern)

title: Eikthyrdeer
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by .
flavor: |The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.
intro: Eikthyrdeer (Japanese: ツノガミ Tsunogami) is a Neutral-element Pal. Eithyrdeer is a medium-sized, deer-like Pal with a predominantly off-white body, purple fur on its back, and large, branching purple antlers with light blue highlights. Eikthyrdeer also has an Ground-element subspecies, Eikthyrdeer Terra.

title: Eikthyrdeer Terra
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.
intro: Eikthyrdeer Terra (Japanese: ヤマガミ Yamagami) is the Ground-element subspecies of Eikthyrdeer. Eikthyrdeer Terra is largely identical to the regular Eikthyrdeer, save for the fact that it has brown fur on its back and golden antlers.

title: Elgrove
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Elgrove changes the player's attack type to Grass and increases Attack.
flavor: |The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.
intro: Elgrove (Japanese: モリタロス Moritarus) is a Grass element Pal. Elgrove also has an Ice-element subspecies, Elgrove Cryst.

title: Elgrove Cryst
partner_skill_desc: While in party, grants the player the ability to Freeze enemies afflicted with Soak in one strike.
flavor: |Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.
intro: Elgrove Cryst is an Ice-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Elgrove.

title: Elizabee
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, stats will increase the more Beegarde are in your team.
flavor: |A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.
intro: Elizabee (Japanese: クインビーナ Queenbeena) is a Grass-element Pal. Elizabee is a large, humanoid Pal with bee-like features. It has a predominantly black body with yellow stripes, fluffy white fur around its neck, a large red plume on its head, and four insectoid wings on its back. Elizabee also wears a black dress with yellow highlights and carries a staff with an ornate golden top in its right hand.

title: Elphidran
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. While fighting together, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.
intro: Elphidran (Japanese: シルフィア Sylphia) is a Dragon element Pal. Elphidran is a medium-sized bipedal draconic Pal with a similar body plan to Dinossom and Relaxaurus. It has a light blue body with a cream-colored belly and a pair of butterfly-like wings with yellow highlights on its back. It also has two horn-like protrusions with yellow highlights on its head and it wears a golden collar with a red gemstone on its neck. Elphidran also has a Dragon / Water element subspecies, Elphidran Aqua.

title: Elphidran Aqua
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.
intro: Elphidran Aqua (Japanese: シルティア Syltear) is the Dragon / Water element subspecies of Elphidran. Elphidran Aqua is largely identical to the regular Elphidran, except for the fact that it has a dark blue body with a lighter blue belly, a blue gemstone in its collar, golden highlights on its wings and a large, teardrop-shaped azure gemstone in its forehead.

title: Enchanted Sword
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Enchanted Sword is a Neutral-element Monster. The Enchanted Sword is a floating blade that's nearly identical to the Excalibur, though it is surrounded by a faint blue glow. The Enchanted Sword is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Eye of Cthulhu
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Eye of Cthulhu charges and attacks targeted enemy.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Eye of Cthulhu is a Dark-element Monster. The Eye of Cthulhu is a large, floating eyeball with a blue gradient iris. It can also shift to a form where the iris is replaced with a large, gaping maw full of sharp teeth. The Eye of Cthulhu is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Faleris
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Ice Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.
intro: Faleris (Japanese: ホルス Horus) is a Fire-element Pal. Faleris is a large, avian Pal reminiscent of a falcon. Its feathers are predominantly black and red, with yellow feathers on the tips of its wings. Faleris also has three large black tail feathers, black feathers around its head, a mohawk-shaped crest, and a red "mask" with yellow highlights on its face. Faleris also has a Water-element subspecies, Faleris Aqua.

title: Faleris Aqua
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.
intro: Faleris Aqua (Japanese: イシス Isis) is the Water-element subspecies of Faleris. Faleris Aqua is largely identical to the regular Faleris, albeit with a more blue color scheme.

title: Faleris Noct
intro: This pal is currently in the data, but not the live game.

title: Felbat
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores Health.
flavor: |Attacking from the shadows, this pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wigs. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.
intro: Felbat (Japanese: ヤミトバリ Yamitobari) is a Dark-element Pal. Felbat is a bipedal, humanoid Pal with a predominantly black body and yellow markings on its hips. It also has billowing white hair similar to a mane with its left eye covered and a single black horn on the right side of its head. Felbat also has no visible arms and wears what appears to be a black cloak with a red interior.

title: Fenglope
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.
flavor: |In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelts and antlers where often seen in works of art.
intro: Fenglope (Japanese: ムラクモ Murakumo) is a Neutral-element pal. Fenglope is a medium-sized, antelope-like Pal with a blue body, black markings on its hind legs, and a pair of large antlers on its head. It also has fluffy white clouds on its chest, back, tail, and hooves. Fenglope also has an Electric-element subspecies, Fenglope Lux.

title: Fenglope Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While fighting together, Water Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.
intro: Fenglope Lux (Japanese: ムラサメ Murasame) is the Electric-element subspecies of Fenglope. Fenglope Lux is largely identical to the regular Fenglope, though with a grey body and yellow markings on its hind legs.

title: Finsider
partner_skill_desc: While in team, Finsider helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of weapons in the player's inventory.
flavor: |It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.
intro: Finsider (Japanese: ガブルミ Gaburumi) is a Water-element Pal. Finsider is a small, bipedal piscine Pal with a predominantly yellow body, a cream-colored belly, orange dorsal fins, and an orange tail fin. It also has a large "mouth" with four sharp teeth and a pair of yellow eyes inside it. Finsider also has a Water / Fire-element subspecies, Finsider Ignis.

title: Finsider Ignis
partner_skill_desc: While in team, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of weapons in the player's inventory. Also increases Attack of Fire Pals.
flavor: |Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.
intro: Finsider Ignis (Japanese: ヒグルミ Higurumi) is the Water / Fire-element subspecies of Finsider. Finsider Ignis is largely identical to the regular Finsider, save for it having a predominantly pink body with red dorsal and tail fins.

title: Flambelle
partner_skill_desc: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes produces Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.
intro: Flambelle (Japanese: ラヴィ Lavi) is a Fire-element Pal. Flambelle is a small, candle-like Pal with white skin and "hair" made of lava. It also wears what appears to be a dress made of molten rock and it has a small flame emanating from its head.

title: Flaracle
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)
flavor: |It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!
intro: Flaracle (Japanese: センコ Senko) is a Fire element Pal.

title: Flopie
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.
flavor: |It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.
intro: Flopie (Japanese: ポプリーナ Potpourrina) is a Grass-element Pal. Flopie is a small, bipedal rabbit-like Pal with a predominantly cream-colored body, pink hands and feet, and a green tuft of fur at the tip of its tail. It also has long pink hair that ends in beige tips, an orange flower in its hair above its left eye, and a green bow on its upper chest.

title: Foxcicle
partner_skill_desc: While in team, increases Attack of Ice Pals. Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to the ranch.
flavor: |On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.
intro: Foxcicle (Japanese: フブキツネ Fubukitsune) is an Ice element Pal. Foxcicle is a small, vulpine Pal with predominantly white fur and pale blue fur on its feet and head. It also has two lengthy tufts of hair with teal highlights hanging from its head, long ears, and three fluffy tails.

title: Foxparks
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.
flavor: |It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.
intro: Foxparks (Japanese: キツネビ Kitsunebi) is a Fire-element Pal. Foxparks is a small, fox-like Pal with a predominantly orange body and beige-colored underbelly and ears. It also has small flames emanating from its legs and the tip of its tail. Foxparks also has an Ice-element subspecies, Foxparks Cryst.

title: Foxparks Cryst
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.
flavor: |It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.
intro: Foxparks Cryst (Japanese: ユキツネ Yukitsune) is the Ice-element subspecies of Foxparks. Foxparks Cryst is largely identical to the regular Foxparks, save for having a light blue body, a white underbelly and ears, and ice enveloping its legs and the tip of its tail.

title: Frostallion
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Ice and enhances Ice attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into an eternal winter.
intro: Frostallion (Japanese: グレイシャル Glacial) is an Ice-element Pal. Frostallion is a large, horse-like Pal with a white body, a grey mane and tail, and icy shards on its hooves, legs, and forehead. It also possesses a pair of large white wings. Frostallion also has a Dark-element subspecies, Frostallion Noct.

title: Frostallion Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark and enhances Dark attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Guardian deity of Palpagos Island known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.
intro: Frostallion Noct (Japanese: グレイシャドウ Glashadow) is the Dark-element subspecies of Frostallion. Frostallion Noct is largely identical to the regular Frostallion, except for the fact that it has a black body, a purple mane, tail and hooves, and gold-colored accents.

title: Frostplume
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens your focus, improving reload speed.
flavor: |So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.
intro: Frostplume (Japanese: クジャンナ Kujanna) is an Ice-element Pal. Frostplume is a medium-sized, avian Pal that resembles a peacock. It has a predominantly white body with light blue markings on its chest and three icy feather-like structures on its head. Frostplume also has a tail covered in large white and light-blue feathers.

title: Fuack
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.
flavor: |Using its own body water, this pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.
intro: Fuack (Japanese: カモノスケ Kamonosuke) is a Water-element Pal. Fuack is a small, bipedal Pal that resembles a platypus. Its body is primarily light blue with a white belly and a large yellow bill. It also has a white collar of fur around its neck, white highlights on its ears, and a large, beaverlike tail. Fuack also has a Water / Fire-element subspecies, Fuack Ignis.

title: Fuack Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.
flavor: |With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.
intro: Fuack Ignis (Japanese: モモノスケ Momonosuke) is the Water / Fire-element subspecies of Fuack. Fuack Ignis is largely identical to the regular Fuack, save for the fact that its body is predominantly reddish-pink.

title: Fuddler
partner_skill_desc: When in party, improves player mining efficiency by and reduces Stone weight by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.
intro: Fuddler (Japanese: モグルン Mogurun) is a Ground-element Pal. Fuddler is a small, bipedal mole-like Pal with a predominantly light brown body, a cream-colored belly and face, and dark brown highlights on its hands and lower body. It also has a collar of yellow fur around its neck.

title: Galeclaw
partner_skill_desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.
flavor: |A pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.
intro: Galeclaw (Japanese: エアムルグ Aimurgh) is a Neutral-element Pal. Galeclaw is a small, avian Pal reminiscent of a bald eagle. Its feathers are mainly brown and white with light blue highlights, with the top sides of its wings also bearing a chartreuse coloring. Galeclaw also has yellow feet and two long, blue-and-green feathers that extend from above its eyes to flowing behind it.

title: Ghangler
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.
flavor: |With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.
intro: Ghangler (Japanese: アンドーン Andōn) is a Dark / Water-element Pal. Ghangler is a medium-sized, piscine Pal that resembles an anglerfish. It has a predominantly black body with a light violet underbelly and two pairs of bony ridges on its underside and back respectively. Its fins end in purple, whispy patterns that resemble flames, with its pectoral fins also having three purple markings on them while its tail fin has three white markings on both sides. The top of Ghangler's head is covered by a skull-like mask with four horn-like protrusions and a hole in the middle. From this hole sprouts Ghangl

title: Ghangler Ignis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.
flavor: |Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.
intro: Ghangler Ignis (Japanese: メラドーン Meradōn) is the Fire / Water-element subspecies of Ghangler. Ghangler Ignis is largely identical to the regular Ghangler, save for the fact that it has a predominantly crimson body with bright red highlights and a orange flame at the tip of its lure.

title: Gildane
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Ground while mounted.
flavor: |During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.
intro: Gildane (Japanese: キンガゼル Kingazelle) is a Ground-element Pal. Gildane is a large, canine Pal with a predominantly white body, a pale blue underbelly, yellow feet, and yellow markings on its sides. It also has two curved yellow horns and a flowing yellow mane and tail with brown tips.

title: Gildra
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0.
flavor: |The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.
intro: Gildra (Japanese: ヨミーラ Yomiira ) is a Dark / Ground element Pal.

title: Gloopie
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the capture gauge decreases more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.
intro: Gloopie (Japanese: ヒメンダコ Himendako) is a Water / Dark-element Pal. Gloopie is a small, semi-humanoid Pal with an octopus-like appearance. It has a white face and arms with curled black tentacles on its head that resemble hair. Additionally, Gloopie's lower half consists of six large black tentacles with purple highlights. Gloopie also has a Water / Neutral-element subspecies, Gloopie Primo.

title: Gloopie Primo
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Defense of Water Pals by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.
intro: Gloopie Primo (Japanese: ユメンダコ Yumendako) is the Water / Neutral-element subspecies of Gloopie. Gloopie Primo is largely identical to the regular Gloopie, except it has a pink color scheme.

title: Gobfin
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Aqua Gun. When this Pal uses Aqua Gun, it has a damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by .
flavor: |Long ago, it was a large and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food become scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.
intro: Gobfin (Japanese: シャーキッド Sharkid) is a Water-element Pal. Gobfin is a small, bipedal Pal with fishlike features. It has a primarily dark blue body with a white underbelly and yellow lightning bolt markings over its eyes and on its belly. It also possesses a sharklike tail and a large fin atop its head, as well as two smaller blue-and-white fins that serve as ears. Gobfin also has a Fire-element subspecies, Gobfin Ignis.

title: Gobfin Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Spirit Fire. When this Pal uses Spirit Fire, it has a damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's Attack by .
flavor: |Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!
intro: Gobfin Ignis (Japanese: シャーマンダー Shāmandā) is the Fire-element subspecies of Gobfin. Gobfin Ignis is largely identical to the regular Gobfin, except for the fact that it has a primarily red body with a yellow underbelly and pinkish lightning bolt markings over its eyes and on its belly.

title: Gorirat
partner_skill_desc: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by 75% for a limited time.
flavor: |It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.
intro: Gorirat (Japanese: ゴリレイジ Gorirage) is a Neutral-element Pal. Gorirat is a medium-sized, gorilla-like Pal mostly covered in black fur with white stripes on its arms and tail. It also has a tuft of white fur on its chest and white tips on its ears. Gorirat also has a Ground-element subspecies, Gorirat Terra.

title: Gorirat Terra
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the player's climbing speed by 50-100%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It communicates with its friends through rhythmic tapping on the ground. Stronger than Gorirat. If every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.
intro: Gorirat Terra (Japanese: ゴリガイア Gorigaia) is the Ground element subspecies of Gorirat. Gorirat Terra is largely identical to the regular Gorirat, except for the fact that its body is mostly covered in light brown fur with dark brown stripes on its arms and tail. It also has a tuft of dark brown fur on its chest and dark brown highlights on its ears.

title: Green Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Green Slime is a Grass-element Monster. The Green Slime is a small, amorphous blob of green slime. The Green Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Grintale
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a 50% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech - its eyes literally light up.
intro: Grintale (Japanese: ニャンギマリ Nyangimari) is a Neutral-element Pal. Grintale is a large, feline Pal with predominantly tan fur, brown fur on its belly, and purple-pink fur on its head, ears, and back. It also has a black split tail, a large, sharp-toothed grin, and bright yellow eyes.

title: Grizzbolt
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.
flavor: |With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.
intro: Grizzbolt (Japanese: エレパンダ Elepanda) is an Electric-element Pal. Grizzbolt is a large, bipedal mammalian Pal with a vague bear-like appearance. Its body is mostly covered in yellow fur, though it has a cream-colored belly and black thunderbolt patterns on its arms and belly. It also has large claws on its hands and feet.

title: Gumoss
partner_skill_desc: While in party, improves logging efficiency by (30%-50%) and reduces weight of all types of wood by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |A strange pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.
intro: Gumoss (Japanese: ナエモチ Naemochi) is a Grass / Ground element Pal. Gumoss is a small, slime-like Pal with a beige-colored body and two small nubs near its face that serve as hands. It also wears a brown, bowl-shaped cap with two large leaves on top of it. Rarely, a Gumoss can be seen with a single Beautiful Flower on its cap.

title: Hangyu
partner_skill_desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.
flavor: |Its strong arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would tear the skin right from their bones.
intro: Hangyu (Japanese: シメナワ Shimenawa) is a Ground-element Pal. Hangyu is a small, round Pal with a spherical tan body, rosy cheeks, a crest of brown hair on its head, and large, flexible arms with brown stripes. Hangyu also has an Ice-element subspecies, Hangyu Cryst.

title: Hangyu Cryst
partner_skill_desc: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascension while gliding.
flavor: |Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation.
intro: Hangyu Cryst (Japanese: オバケナワ Obakenawa) is the Ice-element subspecies of Hangyu. Hangyu Cryst is largely identical to the regular Hangyu, save for the face that it has a pale blue body with white stripes on its arms.

title: Hartalis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.
flavor: |The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here.
intro: Hartalis (Japanese: レジェンディア Legendeer) is a Neutral element pal. Hartalis is a large, deer-like Pal with a predominantly white body and a grey emblem-like patch on its chest. It also has two pairs of flowing, ribbon-like white protrusions at the base of its neck, and a pair of blue, pointed protrusions on the back of each of its legs. Additionally, Hartalis also has long, flowing hair that starts white and gradually becomes more teal as well as a large set of branching antlers with light green and blue tips.

title: Helzephyr
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.
flavor: |It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. One who dies from Helzephyr's inferno is sure to be sent to the underworld.
intro: Helzephyr (Japanese: ヘルガルダ Hellgaruda) is a Dark-element Pal. Helzephyr is a large, avian Pal with a predominantly black body, jagged, crescent-shaped wings, and blue thunderbolt patterns on its wings and tail. Helzephyr also has a blue face and a wispy purple flame emanating from its head. The markings and flame also glow faintly in the dark. Helzephyr also has a Dark / Electric-element subspecies, Helzephyr Lux.

title: Helzephyr Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.
flavor: |It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.
intro: Helzephyr Lux (Japanese: ライガルダ Raigaruda) is the Dark / Electric-element subspecies of Helzephyr. Helzephyr Lux is largely identical to the regular Helzephyr, save for it having a yellow face, a yellow flame on its head, and yellow patterns on its wings and tail.

title: Herbil
partner_skill_desc: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore of the player's Max Health when incapacitated.
flavor: |When in doubt, punch it till it works—that's Herbil's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.
intro: Herbil (Japanese: モモンパ Momonpa) is a Grass / Neutral-element Pal. Herbil is a small, hamster-like Pal with predominantly light brown fur and white fur on its face and belly. It also has a green leaf on its forehead, smaller leaves in front of its ears, and a large leaf for a tail.

title: Hoocrates
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. "I think, therefore I am."
intro: Hoocrates (Japanese: ホウロック Hourokku) is a Dark-element Pal. Hoocrates is a small, owl-like Pal with a predominantly black body with a white belly and eyebrows. It also has a black lightning bolt pattern on its belly and wears what appears to be a large, pointed black hat with a white underside.

title: Hoodle
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat. (Does not stack)
flavor: |When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.
intro: Hoodle (Japanese: フードール Hoodoll) is a Dark element Pal.

title: Icelyn
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Ice.
flavor: |Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.
intro: Icelyn (Japanese: チルウィッチ Chillwitch) is an Ice-element Pal. Icelyn is a small, semi-humanoid Pal with white skin and flowing white hair, a light blue collar, and flowing white hair with light blue tips. It also wears a flowing white dress with light blue highlights and a wide-brimmed witch's hat with ice crystals on it.

title: Illuminant Bat
partner_skill_desc: While in team, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Illuminant Bat is a Neutral-element Monster. The Illuminant Bat is a small, bright purple bat with an oversized head and wings compared to its torso. The Illuminant Bat is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Illuminant Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Illuminant Slime is a Neutral-element Monster. The Illuminant Slime is a small, amorphous blob of pink slime. The Illuminant Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Incineram
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.
flavor: |In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.
intro: Incineram (Japanese: ヘルゴート Hellgoat) is a Fire / Dark-element Pal. Incineram a tall, bipedal goat-like Pal with a predominantly black body and a red hue on its face, stomach, hands, hooves, and the inside of its ears. It also has two curved horns on its head, ribcage-like protrusions sprouting from its torso, a diamond-shaped spike on its chest, and a collar of fluffy white fur around its neck. Incineram also has a pure Dark-element subspecies, Incineram Noct.

title: Incineram Noct
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.
flavor: |It specifically targets baby pals, taking them back to its territory. One can only imagine the profound despair of the parent Pal, whose child has been taken away.
intro: Incineram Noct (Japanese: アビスゴート Abyssgoat) is the pure Dark-element subspecies of Incineram. Incineram Noct is largely identical to the regular Incineram, save for it having a purple hue on its face, stomach, hands, hooves, and the inside of its ears as well as possessing branched, jagged antlers instead of horns.

title: Jelliette
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by . While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette's watering speed increases by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.
intro: Jelliete (Japanese: クララン Kuraran) is a Water-element Pal. Jelliette is a small, humanoid Pal that resembles a jellyfish. It has a predominantly white body with light blue legs and long, flowing white tentacles on its head that resemble hair. It also wears what appears to be a white dress with a blue collar and a wide-brimmed "hat" shaped like a jellyfish's bell.

title: Jellroy
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by . While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy's watering speed increases by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.
intro: Jellroy (Japanese: ユララン Yuraran) is a Water / Dark-element Pal. Jellroy is a small, humanoid Pal with a jellyfish-like appearance. It has a predominantly white body with white blue highlights on its hands, white tentacles on its head that resemble hair, light blue legs, and two white tails with light blue highlights. Jellroy also wears what appears to be a white dress with light blue highlights and a wide-brimmed hat that resembles a jellyfish's bell.

title: Jetragon
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
flavor: |Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.
intro: Jetragon (Japanese: ジェッドラゴン Jedragon) is a Dragon-element Pal.
