Jetragon is a draconic Pal with a predominantly light blue body, a white underbelly, red markings on its forearms and thighs, and white markings on its shark-like tail. Jetragon also has two angular black horns with red highlights as well as a large black protrusion on its back with four orange spikes on it. Attached to each of these spikes are large pinkish diamonds made of energy that resemble wings.

title: Jolthog
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact.
flavor: |It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.
intro: Jolthog (Japanese: パチグリ Pachiguri) is an Electric-element Pal. Jolthog is a small, hedgehog-like Pal with a white body, black feet, and bright yellow spines protruding from its back. Jolthog also has an Ice-element subspecies, Jolthog Cryst.

title: Jolthog Cryst
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.
flavor: |It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.
intro: Jolthog Cryst (Japanese: コチグリ Kochiguri) is the Ice-element subspecies of Jolthog. Jolthog Cryst is largely identical to the regular Jolthog, save for the fact that it has dark blue feet and icy spines on it back.

title: Jormuntide
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, prevents stamina depletion while moving on water.
flavor: |Legend says that the Jormuntide was once a wise man, who after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.
intro: Jormuntide (Japanese: レヴィドラ Levidra) is a Dragon / Water-element Pal. Jormuntide is a large, serpentine Pal with blue scales, a white underbelly and yellow markings on its scales. It also possesses two large fins near its midsection as well as a pair of long whiskers protruding from behind the scales on its head. Jormuntide also has a Dragon / Fire-element subspecies, Jormuntide Ignis.

title: Jormuntide Ignis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.
intro: Jormuntide Ignis (Japanese: アグニドラ Agnidra) is the Dragon / Fire-element subspecies of Jormuntide. Jormuntide Ignis is largely identical to the regular Jormuntide, except for the fact that it has black scales and red fins and markings.

title: Katress
partner_skill_desc: While in party, Neutral Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. Also has a 10% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)
flavor: |With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.
intro: Katress (Japanese: クレメーオ Kuremæw) is a Dark-element Pal. Katress is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with cat-like features. It has a predominantly teal-grey body with lighter grey hair. It wears a large purple witch's hat with cat ears and a purple shawl with white highlights that also covers the bottom half of its face. Katress also wears a black dress with pink highlights under its shawl. Katress also has a Dark / Fire-element subspecies, Katress Ignis.

title: Katress Ignis
partner_skill_desc: While at base, increase the Kinding Work Suitabilty Level for all othe Base Pals by +1
flavor: |Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.
intro: Katress Ignis (Japanese: クレメーナ Kuremēna) is the Dark / Fire element subspecies of Katress. Katress Ignis is largely identical to the regular Katress, albeit with a color scheme resembling Wixen.

title: Kelpsea
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.
intro: Kelpsea (Japanese: ケルピス Kelpis) is a Water element pal. Kelpsea is a small, aquatic Pal with a vague horse-like appearance. It has a predominantly light blue body with a cream-colored belly, dark blue eyes, and dark blue fins on its head, back, and tail. Kelpsea also has a Fire-element subspecies, Kelpsea Ignis.

title: Kelpsea Ignis
partner_skill_desc: While in team, increases Attack of Fire Pals by . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born in. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.
intro: Kelpsea Ignis (Japanese: マグピス Magpis) is the Fire element-subspecies of Kelpsea. Kelpsea Ignis is largely identical to the regular Kelpsea, save for it having a predominantly red body, green eyes, and crimson fins on its head, back, and tail.

title: Kikit
partner_skill_desc: While in team, Kikit helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of crude oil in the player's inventory.
flavor: |A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikits themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.
intro: Kikit (Japanese: コロマジロ Koromadillo) is a Ground-element Pal. Kikit is a small, quadrupedal Pal reminiscent of an armadillo. It has a light tan body with a darker tan shell as well as light brown highlights and diamonds on its shell.

title: Killamari
partner_skill_desc: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.
flavor: |It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.
intro: Killamari (Japanese: ヤミイカ Yamiika) is a Dark / Water-element Pal. Killamari is a small, squid-like Pal with a predominantly light purple body with darker purple highlights and a mouth full of sharp teeth on its underside. It also has a hat-like cap with two ear like protrusions as well as two long tentacles on its sides. Killamari also has a Neutral / Water-element subspecies, Killamari Primo.

title: Killamari Primo
partner_skill_desc: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.
flavor: |It sinks its fangs into the enemy's neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle-each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.
intro: Killamari Primo (Japanese: ユメイカ Yumeika) is the Neutral / Water-element subspecies of Killamari. Killamari Primo is largely identical to the regular Killamari, save for the fact that it has a predominantly white body with pink highlights.

title: Kingpaca
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by for every Melpaca in the party.
flavor: |Melpaca serve this pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.
intro: Kingpaca (Japanese: アルパオー Alpaō) is a Neutral element Pal. Kingpaca is a large, alpaca-like Pal with a head and neck covered in fluffy white wool, a round red body, and four stubby legs also covered in wool. It also has a golden, trident-like protrusion on its forehead and a red cape with golden highlights on its back. Kingpaca also has white patterning with three golden orbs on its chest. Kingpaca also has an Ice-element subspecies, Kingpaca Cryst.

title: Kingpaca Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Defense and Movement Speed increase by for each Melpaca in the party.
flavor: |With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.
intro: Kingpaca Cryst (Japanese: アオパオー Aopaō) is the Ice-element subspecies of Kingpaca. Kingpaca Cryst is largely identical to the regular Kingpaca, save for it having a bluish body, a blue cape, a icy trident-like forehead protrusion, and icy orbs on its chest.

title: Kitsun
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee to a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one were found nearby.
intro: Kitsun (Japanese: シラヌイ Shiranui) is a Fire-element Pal. Kitsun is a medium sized, vulpine Pal with predominantly white fur and light blue highlights on its feet, neck, and tail. It also has light blue markings on its face and a ring of blue flames floats around its neck. Kitsun also has a Dark-element subspecies, Kitsun Noct.

title: Kitsun Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.
flavor: |Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.
intro: Kitsun Noct (Japanese: カゲヌイ Kagenui) is the Dark-element subspecies of Kitsun. Kitsun Noct is largely identical to the regular Kitsun, save for it having a black body with dark purple highlights and magenta flames around its neck.

title: Knocklem
partner_skill_desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack and Defense for a limited time.
flavor: |Can be disassembled into 215 parts, and even if the parts are scattered, it will reassemble itself and start moving again. If parts from different individuals are mixed it will malfunction due to mistaken identity.
intro: Knocklem (Japanese: テラナイト Teraknight) is a Ground-element Pal. Knocklem is a large, humanoid Pal that resembles a suit of armor. Its body is predominantly dark grey with light grey and gold highlights. Knocklem also has a red plume on is head as well as a large golden ring on its back, which it can detach and use as a weapon.

title: Knocklem Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis's Attack by (60~210)% and Defense by (60~210)% for a limited time.
flavor: |Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.
intro: Knocklem Ignis is a Fire-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Knocklem.

title: Lamball
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.
intro: Lamball (Japanese: モコロン Mokoron) is a Neutral-element Pal. Lamball is a small, sheep-like bipedal Pal with a spherical body mostly covered with white wool. It also possesses a pair of small yellow horns and two crystals on its chest.

title: Lapiron
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the player's Defense while sprinting. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.
intro: Lapiron (Japanese: バトラビー Batorabii) is a Ground element Pal.

title: Lapure
partner_skill_desc: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.
intro: Lapure (Japanese: ネモフィ Nemophi) is a Neutral element Pal.

title: Leafan
partner_skill_desc: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 2% for each other Grass Pal in your party.
flavor: |To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!
intro: Leafan (Japanese: リーファン Leafan) is a Grass element Pal.

title: Leezpunk
partner_skill_desc: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.
flavor: |A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.
intro: Leezpunk (Japanese: ダリザード Dalizard) is a Dark-element Pal. Leezpunk is a small, bipedal reptilian Pal with a predominantly purple body and an orange underbelly. It also has yellow spikes along its tail and wears a black hoodie with yellow markings on it and a yellow crest on the hood. Leezpunk also has a Fire-element subspecies, Leezpunk Ignis.

title: Leezpunk Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.
flavor: |A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.
intro: Leezpunk Ignis (Japanese: チリザード Chilizard) is the Fire-element subspecies of Leezpunk. Leezpunk Ignis is largely idenitcal to the regular Leezpunk, save for the fact that it wears a red hoodie with orange markings and an orange crest on the hood.

title: Lifmunk
partner_skill_desc: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follow up the player attacks.
flavor: |Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.
intro: Lifmunk (Japanese: クルリス Kururisu) is a Grass-element Pal. Lifmunk is a small, squirrel-like Pal. Its body is mainly a light chartreuse color. It has a red cherry-like protrusion on its torso and a sort of red gemstone on its forehead, leaves for ears and also around its neck and on its cheeks.

title: Loomen
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.
intro: Loomen (Japanese: ヴィランタン Villaintern) is a Dark / Fire element Pal.

title: Loupmoon
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Jumping Claw. When this Pal uses Jumping Claw, it has a damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.
intro: Loupmoon (Japanese: ツキカゲ Tsukikage) is a Dark-element Pal. Loupmoon is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with vague rabbit-like appearance. It has a predominantly black body, a dark grey face and belly, and fluffy white fur covering the top half of its torso and on its tail. Loupmoon also has red claws on its hands and feet, large pointed ears, and a pair of crescent-shaped black horns atop its head. Loupmoon also has an Ice-element subspecies, Loupmoon Cryst.

title: Loupmoon Cryst
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw. When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player's melee weapon attack speed by. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.
intro: Loupmoon Cryst (Japanese: ユキカゲ Yukikage) is the Ice-element subspecies of Loupmoon. Loupmoon Cryst is largely identical to the regular Loupmoon, expect for the fact that it has a predominantly white body, a bluish-white face and belly, light blue claws on its hands and feet, and icy horns.

title: Lovander
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealth as Health..
flavor: |Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.
intro: Lovander (Japanese: ラブマンダー Lovemander) is a Dark-element Pal. Lovander is a tall, humanoid Pal with a salamander-like appearance. It has a predominantly light-pink body with a white belly, hot pink tufts of fur around its wrists, and a heart-shaped patch of pink fur on its chest. It also has a small purple and pink heart covering its nether regions, wavy pink hair, and two purple and pink tails.

title: Lullu
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, Lullu fills the farm with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops.
flavor: |In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie's hay fever is Lullu's fault.
intro: Lullu (Japanese: フワフラワ Fuwaflower) is a Grass element Pal. Lullu is a small, plant-like Pal with white skin, peach-colored hair, and a bow made of green leaves. It also wears what appears to be a white crown with yellow-orange flower petals on top and a dress made of white and orange flower petals with green tips on the orange petals.

title: Lunaris
partner_skill_desc: While in party, spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.
intro: Lunaris (Japanese: ミステリア Mysteria) is a Neutral-element Pal. Lunaris is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with a thin white body and a blue circle on its face. Its long legs end in conical blue points instead of feet and its arms end in bulbous, three-fingered hands. Lunaris also has a small turquoise gemstone in its chest, a larger gemstone in its forehead, two horn-like protrusions with blue tips on its head, and two large tendrils resembling hair.

title: Lyleen
partner_skill_desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.
flavor: |A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.
intro: Lyleen (Japanese: リリクイン Lilyqueen) is a Grass-element Pal. Lyleen is humanoid, plant-like Pal with an olive-green body wearing a layered, flowing dress made from leaves and flower petals. It wears two dark green leaves on its shoulders and another two leaves on its head that resemble pigtails. Lyleen also has red eyes, a very small mouth, no nose and two red-orange lilies growing from its head. Lyleen also has a Dark-element subspecies, Lyleen Noct.

title: Lyleen Noct
partner_skill_desc: When activated, the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.
flavor: |An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.
intro: Lyleen Noct (Japanese: ルナクイン Lunaqueen) is the Dark-element subspecies of Lyleen. Lyleen Noct is largely identical in appearance to the regular Lyleen, save for it having light blue skin, a galaxy blue and light blue dress with golden highlights, blue hair, and crystal blue lilies on its head.

alpha.name: Cold Resistant Refined Metal Armor Schematic 4

title: Majex
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)
flavor: |It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.
intro: Majex (Japanese: マジョルナ Majoluna) is a Dark / Fire element Pal.

title: Mammorest
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.
flavor: |The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.
intro: Mammorest (Japanese: グランモス Granmosu) is a Grass / Ground-element Pal. Mammorest is a large, elephant-like pal with brown skin and a thick layer of green vegetation covering its back and the top of its trunk. It also has two large, rocky protrusions on its back, stony bands around its ankles, and two rock-like tusks. Mammorest also has an Ice / Ground-element subspecies, Mammorest Cryst.

title: Mammorest Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.
flavor: |The vegetation on its back varies from individual to individual. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.
intro: Mammorest Cryst (Japanese: ブリザモス Burizamosu) is the Ice / Ground-element subspecies of Mammorest. Mammorest Cryst is largely identical to the regular Mammorest, save for the fact that it has light grey skin, white vegetation covering its back and the top of its trunk, and icy back protrusions, ankle bracers, and tusks.

title: Maraith
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30% whenever you defeat an enemy. (does not stack)
flavor: |It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.
intro: Maraith (Japanese: ソルレイス Solraith) is a Dark-element Pal. Maraith is a medium-sized, quadrupedal Pal that looks like a vague cross between a horse and a lion. It has a black body and a small white face with glowing green eyes. Its legs end in sharp purple points and it has two wings made of ghostly blue fire. It also has a small blue flame on both its forehead and the tip of its tail.

title: Mau
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to the ranch.
flavor: |Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails to bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who where poached as a result, they were anything but.
intro: Mau (Japanese: ニャオテト Nyaotet) is a Dark-element Pal. Mau is a small, feline Pal with a predominantly black body and golden markings on its face, ears, legs, and tail. It also wears a golden collar and has a golden ornament at the tip of its tail. Mau also has an Ice-element subspecies, Mau Cryst.

title: Mau Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.
intro: Mau Cryst (Japanese: チルテト Chirutet) is the Ice-element subspecies of Mau. Mau Cryst is largely identical to the regular Mau, save for the fact that it has a pale blue body with darker blue highlights, an icy collar and tail ornament, and an icy crystal on its forehead.

title: Melpaca
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.
intro: Melpaca (Japanese: メルパカ Melpaca) is a Neutral element Pal. Melpaca is a medium-sized alpaca-like Pal. It is much smaller and slimmer then the Kingpaca. It has pink skin, and its body is covered with white wool. Its legs take on the appearance of tall boots, and each boot has a purple marking at the tip.

title: Menasting
partner_skill_desc: While in party, player's Defense increases by 5% , and Electric Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.
intro: Menasting (Japanese: デスティング Deathting) is a Dark / Ground-element Pal. Menasting is a large, scorpion-like Pal with a predominantly black body, four legs that end in sharp points, a pair of large pincers, and a large, bladed stinger. It also has bluish flames emanating from its back as well as purple highlights all over its body. Menasting also has a pure Ground-element subspecies, Menasting Terra.

title: Menasting Terra
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |The main body is an entity made of energy, with nothing inside. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are stuck by it can only let out hellish groans.
intro: Menasting Terra (Japanese: ゴルディング Golding) is the pure Ground-element subspecies of Menasting. Menasting Terra is largely identical to the regular Menasting, though it has a predominantly silvery body with golden highlights as well as yellow flames emanating from its back.

title: Mimog
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key. Does not apply to chests that require a specific Work Suitability.
flavor: |There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for "being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death."
intro: Mimog (Japanese: ミミドッグ Mimidog) is a Neutral-element Pal. Mimog closely resembles the Treasure Chests seen throughout the Palpagos Islands, though with visually-distinctive markings, a slightly more rounded shape, and a pair of ear-like protrusions on top of it. When active, Mimog's lid slightly opens to reveal a "face" consisting of two bright blue eyes and a long tongue. It also possesses four short legs that are only seen in its active state.

title: Moldron
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal's Attack increases for each other Fire or Ground Pal in your party.
flavor: |In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.
intro: Moldron (Japanese: マグマンダー Magmander) is a Fire / Ground element Pal. Moldron also has an Ice / Ground-element subspecies, Moldron Cryst.

title: Moldron Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Ice attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by (25~40)%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.
intro: Moldron Cryst is an Ice / Ground-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Moldron.

title: Mossanda
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.
flavor: |A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this pal tore through 3,000 pieces of paper at once! It's only by some miracle this Pal isn't a meat-eater.
intro: Mossanda (Japanese: ササゾー Sasazō) is a Grass-element Pal. Mossanda is a large, bipedal Pal with a panda-like appearance. It has a white upper body, a black lower body and arms, green markings on its hands, and a bow made of leaves on its chest. Its head and face are also covered in bright green hair and it has a large leaf sticking from the top of its head. Mossanda also has an Electric-element subspecies, Mossanda Lux.

title: Mossanda Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.
flavor: |A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal has been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.
intro: Mossanda Lux (Japanese: ライゾー Raizō) is the Electric-element subspecies of Mossanda. Mossanda Lux is largely identical to the regular Mossanda, save for having yellow markings on its hands, lightning bolt markings on its chest bow, yellow hair with light brown highlights covering its face and head, and a large glowing yellow mohawk.

title: Mozzarina
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.
intro: Mozzarina (Japanese: ミルカルビ Mirukarubi) is a Neutral-element Pal. Mozzarina is a large, bovine Pal with a round, black-and-white body, four stumpy legs, two small horns on its head, and pink udders on its underside. It also has a pair of small fangs.

title: Muffly
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.
intro: Muffly (Japanese: モコチッチ Mokochicchi) is a Ice element Pal. Muffly is a small, avian Pal resembling a robin. It has an ice blue body and a white face, surrounded by a fluffy ring that makes it look like it's wearing a snow jacket. Its beak and the plume on its head are blue, and it has two round, black eyes.

title: Munchill
partner_skill_desc: While in team, Munchill cools ingredients inside its mouth, making the food in your inventory less likely to spoil.
flavor: |The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans—whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.
intro: Munchill (Japanese: コチワニ Kochiwani) is an Ice / Water-element Pal. Munchill is a small, quadrupedal reptilian Pal with a round body and four stubby legs. It has a white lower body and a light blue upper body, with diamond-shaped pale blue markings on its upper body along with two small blue spikes on top of it. Munchill also has a large mouth with two icy teeth on its lower jaw.

title: Mycora
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.
intro: Mycora (Japanese: マシュリー Mushley) is a Grass-element Pal.

title: Necromus
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.
flavor: |Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.
intro: Necromus (Japanese: べイントール Banetaur) is a Dark-element Pal. Necromus is a large, centaur-like Pal with a black body and a large dark purple tail. Its humanoid upper body and four legs are covered in black armor with red highlights on the torso and helment and dark purple highlights on the leg armor. It also has a large, wing-shaped red plume atop its helmet. In place of hands, Necromus has two large lances made of red crystal and rimmed in dark purple metal at their bases.

alpha.name: Heat Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

title: Needoll
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.
intro: Needoll (Japanese: ハグミー Hugme) is a Grass element Pal. Needoll also has a Dark/Grass sub species, Needoll Noct.

title: Needoll Noct
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the player's attacks increase Ivy-Covered buildup by (2~6) . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.
intro: Needoll Noct (Japanese: ハグユー Hugyou) is a Dark and Grass element Pal. It is a sub species of Needoll.

title: Neptilius
partner_skill_desc: While in party, it follows up the player's attacks with Water spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water.
flavor: |After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.
intro: Neptilius (Japanese: ネプティオス Neptius) is a Water-element Pal. Neptilius is a large, whale-like Pal with a predominantly grey body and a white and blue underbelly. It has multiple azure gemstones with golden rims on its back, pectoral fins, and tail fin. Neptilius also has a golden "crown" resembling antlers as well as another large azure gem on its head, along with six long, flowing "tentacles" seemingly made of hair.

title: Nitemary
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Pals drop more Pal Souls when defeated.
flavor: |What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.
intro: Nitemary (Japanese: ナイトメアリ Nitemary) is a Dark-element Pal. Nitemary is a small, humanoid rabbit-like Pal with a white face, black ears and limbs, and light teal hair. It also wears a white dress with black highlights and a fluffy black collar. Nitemary also carries a small blue flame in its right hand.

title: Nitemary Botan
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Defense of Grass Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.
intro: Nitemary Botan is a Grass-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Nitemary.

title: Nitewing
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount.
flavor: |It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.
intro: Nitewing (Japanese: ホークウィン Hawkwin) is a Neutral-element Pal. Nitewing is a large, avian Pal reminiscent of a hawk or an eagle. It has a predominantly grey body with a white underbelly, white highlights on its wings, yellow feet, and red markings on its facial feathers, wings, and tail.

title: Nox
partner_skill_desc: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies.
flavor: |If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.
intro: Nox (Japanese: ルナティ Runati) is a Dark-element Pal. Nox is a small, fox-like Pal with a predominantly pale periwinkle body with white highlights on its ears, feet, and tail. It also has a collar of white fur around its neck and a dark purple cloak with white highlights on its back. Nox also has a small purple gemstone on its chest.

title: Nyafia
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time.
flavor: |Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.
intro: Nyafia (Japanese: ニャニミテ Nyanimite) is a Dark-element Pal. Nyafia is a medium-sized, humanoid feline Pal with predominantly light grey fur, black feet, and bright magenta hair that covers its right eye. It also wears a long-sleeved black dress with magenta highlights.

title: Omascul
partner_skill_desc: While in team, the Pals in the team gain more experience points.
flavor: |The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.
intro: Omascul (Japanese: オーメン Ōmen) is a Dark-element Pal. Omascul is a medium-sized, bipedal Pal with a vague, penguin-like body shape. Its body is predominantly black with grey feet and a white, mask-like face with red highlights. Omascul also has four hidden arms and a mouth full of sharp teeth hidden under its "mask."

title: Ophydia
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Soak. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.
intro: Ophydia (Japanese: ハナミズチ Hanamizuchi) is a Grass / Water element Pal.

title: Orserk
partner_skill_desc: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 1% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.
intro: Orserk (Japanese: ボルゼクス Boruzekusu) is a Dragon / Electric-element Pal. Orserk is a bipedal, draconic Pal with orca-like features. It has a predominantly black body with a white belly, yellow feet, two curved yellow horns on its head, and yellow thunderbolt markings on its forearms, midsection, and the back of its neck. Orserk also has two jagged, butterfly-like yellow wings on its back as well as two jagged yellow fins on its tail.

title: Paladius
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted.
flavor: |Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.
intro: Paladius (Japanese: セイントール Saintaur) is a Neutral-element Pal. Paladius a large, centaur-like Pal with a predominantly grey body and a large yellow tail. Its humanoid upper body and four legs are covered in azure-colored armor with golden highlights. It also has two large, wing-shaped adornments on its helmet and two smaller wing-shaped adornments on the knees of its rear legs. In its right hand, Paladius carries a large azure shield rimmed in gold and with a golden emblem on the front. In its left hand is a large lance made of blue crystal and rimmed in gold at the base.

alpha.name: Cold Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

title: Palumba
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Runs faster over grass.
flavor: |Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?
intro: Palumba (Japanese: ココヤンバ Cocoyamba) is a Grass-element Pal. Palumba is a large, bipedal avian Pal that looks like a cross between a chicken and a palm tree. It has a brown lower body and a green upper body with dark green leafy protrusions on its arms. It also has yellow-green markings on its neck and an orange flower flanked with large green palm leaves on its head.

title: Panthalus
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.
flavor: |The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.
intro: Panthalus (Japanese: グランジーラ Granjiira) is a Water element Pal.

title: Pengullet
partner_skill_desc: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on contact and is incapacitated.
flavor: |The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.
intro: Pengullet (Japanese: ぺンタマ Pentama) is a Water / Ice-element Pal. Pengullet is a small, penguin-like Pal with a predominantly blue body, a white face and belly, a yellow bill and feet, and white highlights on its flippers and the plume on its head. It also has a small, teardrop-shaped red protrusion on its belly. Pengullet also has a Water / Electric-element subspecies, Pengullet Lux.

title: Pengullet Lux
partner_skill_desc: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher and fires Pengullet Lux as ammunition. Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated.
flavor: |The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy- so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.
intro: Pengullet Lux (Japanese: デンタマ Dentama) is the Water / Electric subspecies of Pengullet. Pengullet Lux is largely identical to the regular Pengullet, save for the fact that it has a predominantly black body with yellow highlights on its flippers and head.

title: Penking
partner_skill_desc: While in party, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.
intro: Penking (Japanese: キャプペン Cappen) is a Water / Ice-element Pal. Penking is medium-sized, penguin-like Pal with a predominantly blue body, a white face and belly, a yellow bill, eyebrows and feet, and light blue flippers. It also has a large white collar and three oval-shaped red protrusions on its belly. Additionally, Penking also wears a large blue captain's hat with light blue highlights and a red plume on top, a dark blue coat with white highlights, and yellow epaulets on its shoulders. Penking also has a Water / Electric-element subspecies, Penking Lux.

title: Penking Lux
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Water attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet- but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux.
intro: Penking Lux (Japanese: ペンキッド Penkidd) is the Water / Electric-element subspecies of Penking. Penking Lux is largely identical to the regular Penking, save for the fact that it has a predominantly black body, a grey hat with golden highlights, and a grey cloak.

title: Petallia
partner_skill_desc: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 75%. While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.
intro: Petallia (Japanese: フラリーナ Florina) is a Grass-element Pal. Petallia is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with plant-like features. It has white skin on its face and arms along with long green hair. It also wears a long green dress with white highlights as well as a large green crown with two flowers in it.

title: Petallia Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by (80~90)%. While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Grass damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)
flavor: |A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.
intro: Petallia Ignis is a Grass / Fire-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Petallia.

title: Pierdon
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.
intro: Pierdon (Japanese: ジオルドン Geordon) is a Ground element Pal. Pierdon also has an Ice-element subspecies, Pierdon Cryst.

title: Pierdon Cryst
partner_skill_desc: While in party, player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Dragon damage. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.
intro: Pierdon Cryst (Japanese: フロスドン Frosdon) is an Ice-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Pierdon.

title: Polapup
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Runs faster over snow. Can slide quickly down slopes.
flavor: |Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.
intro: Polapup (Japanese: バニザラシ Vanizarashi) is an Ice / Water-element Pal. Polapup is a small, pinniped Pal with a predominantly light blue body and a white head. It also has a blue nose and a light blue horn that resembles an ice cream cone. Polapup also has an Ice / Ground-element subspecies, Polapup Terra.

title: Polapup Terra
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by (80~160)% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.
flavor: |Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.
intro: Polapup Terra is an Ice / Ground-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Polapup. Polapup Terra is a small, pinniped Pal with a predominantly dark brown body and a light brown head. It also has a dark brown snout and a light brown horn that resembles an ice cream cone.

title: Prixter
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by 50%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |It has about 5,000 types of poison. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but all of them are too weak to have any effect.
intro: Prixter (Japanese: ブッサソリ Bussasori) is a Dark / Ground-element Pal. Prixter is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with scorpion-like features. It has a predominantly purple body with light purple and grey highlights, two large pincers for hands, pointed feet, and a tail with a sharp, bladed stinger.

title: Prixter Lux
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by (30~50)%.
flavor: |It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.
intro: Prixter Lux is a Electric / Ground-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Prixter.

title: Prunelia
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest.
flavor: |Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.
intro: Prunelia (Japanese: プラムルリム Plumrurimu) is a Grass / Dark-element Pal. Prunelia is a humanoid, plant-like Pal similar to Petallia or Lyleen. Its body is predominantly light violet, with slightly darker hair and wearing a dark purple dress with light violet markings. Four arm-like protrusions extend from its back and it wears what appears to be a bow-tie made from leaves on its neck.

title: Puffolt
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.
intro: Puffolt (Japanese: パチマル Pachimaru) is an Electric element Pal.

title: Pupperai
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the player's melee weapon damage by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to "stay" is risky business, as the "go" command triggers that same attack instinct.
intro: Pupperai (Japanese: ポチムネ Pochimune) is a Ground element Pal. Pupperai is a canine Pal with brown fur across most of its body and white fur on its muzzle and paws. The fur on its bushy tail, the tuft on its head, its eyebrows, and the insides of its ears are all black. A stick pokes out of Pupperai's tail, which the Pal wields as a weapon. It has a patch of thick, rich brown fur around its neck that resembles a bandana, and a ring of similar fur at the base of its head tuft that resembles a hairband.

title: Purple Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Purple Slime is a Dark-element Monster. The Purple Slime is a medium-sized, amorphous blob of purple slime. The Purple Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Pyrin
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.
flavor: |Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. When someone has mounted it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.
intro: Pyrin (Japanese: サラブレイズ Thoroughblaze) is a Fire-element Pal. Pyrin is a medium-sized, equine Pal with indigo skin and yellow markings near its neck and on its back. It also has two flame decals on its shoulders, small flames on its ankles, a flaming mane and tail, and a small brown horn on its forehead. Pyrin also has a Fire / Dark-element subspecies, Pyrin Noct.

title: Pyrin Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack to Dark and increases Attack by 5%
flavor: |It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.
intro: Pyrin Noct (Japanese: サラブラック Thoroughblack) is the Fire / Dark-element subspecies of Pyrin. Pyrin Noct is largely identical to the regular Pyrin, save for it having purple-blue markings and flames as well as a blue horn on its forehead.

title: Quivern
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.
flavor: |Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.
intro: Quivern (Japanese: フェスキー Fesukii) is a Dragon-element Pal. Quivern is a large, bipedal draconic Pal covered in white fur. It also has a pair of large feathered wings and two large feathers resembling ears protruding from the top of its head. Quivern also has a Dragon / Grass-element subspecies, Quivern Botan.

title: Quivern Botan
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.
flavor: |When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.
intro: Quivern Botan (Japanese: フォレスキー Foresukii) is the Grass-element subspecies of Quivern. Quivern Botan is largely identical to the regular Quivern, albeit with a more green color scheme.

title: Ragnahawk
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5% .
flavor: |Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.
intro: Ragnahawk (Japanese: イグニクス Ignix) is a Fire-element Pal. Ragnahawk is a large, avian Pal reminiscent of a hawk. It has predominantly red-orange feathers, with its back and the top sides of its wings being black. Ragnahawk also has a black "mask" with yellow highlights on its face, a large red-orange plume on its head, and a segmented black shell with yellow highlights on its back.

title: Rainbow Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Rainbow Slime is a Neutral-element Monster. The Rainbow Slime is a medium-sized, amorphous blob of rainbow-colored slime. The Rainbow Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Rayhound
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5% for each Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)
flavor: |At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. If two Rayhounds collide, the sound is like that of a powerful thunderclap.
intro: Rayhound (Japanese: イヌズマ Inuzuma) is an Electric-element Pal. Rayhound is a medium-sized canine Pal with predominantly brown fur as well as white fur on its chest and yellow thunderbolt markings on its back. It also has two large thunderbolt-like protrusions on its forelegs, four smaller thunderbolt-like protrusions near its feet, and one large one on the tip of its tail. Rayhound also has an Ice-element subspecies, Rayhound Cryst.

title: Rayhound Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals by 15~30% . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.
intro: Rayhound Cryst (Japanese: フリーズマ Freezuma) is an Ice-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Rayhound.

title: Red Slime
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can jump high into the air while mounted.
flavor: |[Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.
intro: The Red Slime is a Fire-element Pal. The Red Slime is a small, amorphous blob of red slime. The Red Slime is a part of the Palworld–Terraria crossover.

title: Reindrix
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Keeps the rider cool in hot environments.
flavor: |Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen over and smashed to pieces.
intro: Reindrix (Japanese: ツララジカ Tsurarajika) is an Ice-element Pal. Reindrix is a large, deer-like Pal with predominantly pale blue fur and darker blue patterns and highlights. It also has long, drooping ears and a large pair of icy antlers.

title: Relaxaurus
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
flavor: |Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.
intro: Relaxaurus (Japanese: ペコドン Pekodon) is a Dragon / Water-element Pal. Relaxaurus is a large, bipedal dinosaur-like Pal with a similar body plan to Dinossom and Elphidran. It has a predominantly light blue body with a cream-colored belly and a dark blue pattern on its back. Relaxaurus also has a Dragon / Electric-element subspecies, Relaxaurus Lux.

title: Relaxaurus Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
flavor: |One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!
intro: Relaxaurus Lux (Japanese: パリピドン Paripidon) is the Dragon / Electric-element subspecies of Relaxaurus. Relaxaurus Lux is largely identical to the regular Relaxaurus, save for it having a predomiantly bright yellow body, a black pattern on its back, and a glowing yellow mohawk on its head.

title: Renjishi
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Burn 2~6. (Does not stack)
flavor: |At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.
intro: Renjishi (Japanese: ゴウカブキ Goukabuki) is a Fire element Pal.

title: Reptyro
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces the weight of all types of ore by 30%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, this water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.
intro: Reptyro (Japanese: ボルカノン Volcanon) is a Fire / Ground-element Pal. Reptyro is a large, quadrupedal reptilian Pal with a turtle-like appearance. It has a predominantly light brown body with cinnabar markings on its legs and feet. Reptyro also has four horns on its head and a dark brown shell on its back, with flames spewing out from the gaps between the plates on its shell. Reptyro also has an Ice / Ground-element subspecies, Reptyro Cryst.

title: Reptyro Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of ore by 35% . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.
intro: Reptyro Cryst (Japanese: フロスカノン Froscanon) is the Ice / Ground-element subspecies of Reptyro. Reptyro Cryst is largely identical to the regular Reptyro, save for it having blue markings on its legs and feet, blue horns, and bluish flames spewing out from the gaps between the plates on its shell.

title: Ribbuny
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by . (Does not stack). While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.
intro: Ribbuny (Japanese: ヒメウサ Himeusa) is a Neutral element Pal. Ribbuny is a small, rabbit-like Pal with a predominantly white body and pink coloration on its head and ears. It also has two ribbon-like tentacles protruding from its back nad a pink bow on its forehead. Ribbuny also has a Grass-element subspecies, Ribbuny Botan.

title: Ribbuny Botan
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Grass attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by . (Does not stack) Increases efficiency by when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.
flavor: |Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.
intro: Ribbuny Botan (Japanese: ヨモギウサ Yomogiusa) is the Grass-element subspecies of Ribbuny. Ribbuny Botan is largely identical to the regular Ribbuny, albeit with a more green color scheme and a yellow bow on its forehead.

title: Robinquill
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the player's bow damage.
flavor: |A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans so long ago.
intro: Robinquill (Japanese: フェザーロ Featherro) is a Grass-element Pal. Robinquill is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with a black body, bright green hair, and a crest of white-and-orange feathers on its head. It also wears long green pants with white highlights as well as an orange cloak. Robinquill also has a Grass / Ground-element subspecies, Robinquill Terra.

title: Robinquill Terra
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, allows you to deal more damage to weak points.
flavor: |A Pal that lives a hunting life in rocky areas and is very close to humans. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.
intro: Robinquill Terra (Japanese: サンドロ Sandoro) is the Grass / Ground-element subspecies of Robinquill. Robinquill Terra is largely identical to the regular Robinquill, except for the fact that it has a brown body, yellow hair, a brownish-red cloak, and yellow pants with white highlights.

title: Rooby
partner_skill_desc: While in team, increases Defense of Fire Pals by . (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Wild Rooby surprisingly never gets sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.
intro: Rooby (Japanese: ヒノコジカ Hinokoshika) is a Fire-element Pal. Rooby is a small, fawn-like Pal with a predominantly cream colored body and red-orange fur on its back, head, and tail. It also has red bands on its front legs, a dark band on its tail, a pinkish bow on its neck, and a flame emanating from its head.

title: Roujay
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind. (Does not stack)
flavor: |A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.
intro: Roujay (Japanese: アルセーヴ Arusēv) is a Dark element Pal.

title: Rushoar
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by .
flavor: |Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can send even boulders flying.
intro: Rushoar (Japanese: イノボウ Inobou) is a Ground-element Pal. Rushoar is a medium-sized, boar-like Pal with a predominantly light-brown body, light tan stripes around its face and on its back, dark brown legs, and a long snout with a pair of tusks. Rushoar also has large blue eyes and a crest of mohawk-like, dark brown fur on its back.

title: Sekhmet
partner_skill_desc: While at base, boosts Anubis's work speed. Increases efficiency if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.
intro: Sekhmet (Japanese:) is a Ground element Pal. Sekhmet is a sleek, bipedal humanoid feline styled after ancient Egyptian royalty, featuring a smooth and athletic build with distinctive cat-like facial features, pointed ears, and sharp eyes. The creature wears ornate, traditional Egyptian-inspired gold and blue accessories, including a regal neck collar and a striped, pharaoh-style headpiece that frames its face.

title: Selyne
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Neutral and Dark attacks while mounted.
flavor: |The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.
intro: Selyne (Japanese: セレムーン Selemoon) is a Dark / Neutral-element Pal. Selyne is a tall, humanoid Pal with a dark grey body wearing what appears to be a white dress with a dark grey rim and golden highlights. It also wears what appears to be a large golden ribbon and possesses a large, crescent-shaped crest on its forehead. Floating behind Selyne is a large crescent moon colored purple and blue and possessing more golden highlights.

title: Shadowbeak
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by while mounted.
flavor: |Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence should not be. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.
intro: Shadowbeak (Japanese: ゼノグリフ Xenogrif) is a Dark-element Pal. Shadowbeak is a large, quadrupedal Pal reminiscent of a griffon. Its body is black with two large wings, bird-like forelegs, and wing-shaped crest on its head. It also has a spiked black ring with neon blue highlights around its midsection.

title: Shaolong
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal's Attack increases by (4~8)% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.
flavor: |Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership
intro: Shaolong is a Dragon / Water elemental Pal with a serpentine white and blue body, golden horns and a large white mane.

title: Shroomer
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.
intro: Shroomer (Japanese: キノッポ Kinoppo) is a Grass-element Pal. Shroomer is a medium-sized, dinosaur-like Pal with a predominantly green body and a cream-colored belly. It also has a large red mushroom cap with white spots on its head and a smaller one on the tip of its tail. Shroomer also has a Grass / Dark subspecies, Shroomer Noct.

title: Shroomer Noct
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by 10%.
flavor: |The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.
intro: Shroomer Noct (Japanese: べノッポ Venoppo) is the Grass / Dark element subspecies of Shroomer. Shroomer Noct is largely identical to the regular Shroomer, save for it having a predominantly purple body as well as a purple mushroom cap on its head.

title: Sibelyx
partner_skill_desc: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Blizzard Spike. Sometimes produces High Quality Cloth when assigned to the ranch.
intro: Sibelyx (Japanese: シルキーヌ Silkine) is an Ice-element Pal. Sibelyx is a tall, semi-humanoid Pal with a vague moth-like appearance. It has an hourglass-shaped body with predominantly white coloration, grey stripes, and some light blue highlights. Its arms are shaped like wings and it wears what appears to be a large, wide-brimmed hat with two antennae on top. Sibelyx also has a Neutral-element subspecies, Sibelyx Primo.

title: Sibelyx Primo
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Defense of Neutral Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.
intro: Sibelyx Primo is a Neutral -element Pal. It is a subspecies of Sibelyx. Sibelyx Primo is a tall, semi-humanoid Pal with a vague moth-like appearance. It has an hourglass-shaped body with predominantly white coloration, black stripes, and some gold highlights. Its arms are shaped like wings and it wears what appears to be a large, wide-brimmed hat with two antennae on top.

title: Silvance
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to 40% of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants immunity to the World Tree's Explosive Spores to both the player ahd their Pals.
flavor: |Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, or for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.
intro: Silvance (Japanese: モスローン Mothrone) is a Grass element Pal.

title: Silvegis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Increases the duration of the shield when using Aegis Charge while mounted.
flavor: |The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.
intro: Silvegis (Japanese: アイギルガ Aegilga) is a Dragon-element Pal. Silvegis is a large, quadrupedal draconic Pal with a predominantly white body, a grey underbelly, and grey stripes on its neck and forelegs. It also has golden armor on its feet, a metal and gold collar around its neck, and a dark grey armored crest with glowing, jagged light blue fins.

title: Skutlass
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,600 ) If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.
flavor: |A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
intro: Skutlass (Japanese: オオタチウオ Ohtachiuo) is a Water element Pal. Skutlass also has a Water/Fire subspecies, Skutlass Ignis.

title: Skutlass Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,900~4,200 ). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iagiri is used.
flavor: |A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
intro: Skutlass Ignis (Japanese: ヒノタチウオ Hinotachiuo) is the Water / Fire-element subspecies of Skutlass.

title: Slowatt
partner_skill_desc: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)
flavor: |Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.
intro: Slowatt (Japanese: ノンビリリ Nonbiriri) is an Electric element Pal.

title: Smokie
partner_skill_desc: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, a large amount of Chromite is obtained.
flavor: |The black flames are only warm to the touch, but anything that remains in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese above them, and it becomes a true delicacy.
intro: Smokie (Japanese: クロマル Kuromaru) is a Dark-element Pal. Smokie is a small, canine Pal with mostly black fur with some red and grey highlights. It also has wispy grey smoke coming from its head and on its tail. Smokie also has a Dark / Ice-element subspecies, Smokie Cryst.

title: Smokie Cryst
partner_skill_desc: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!
intro: Smokie Cryst is a Dark / Ice-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Smokie.

title: Snock
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.
intro: Snock (Japanese: デンツム Dentsumu) is an Electric element Pal.

title: Snock Terra
partner_skill_desc: While in party, >player and party Pals take (15~30)% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Tossing a heated Snock Terra into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.
intro: Snock Terra (Japanese: ドンツム Dontsumu) is an Electric element Pal.

title: Snugloo
partner_skill_desc: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)
flavor: |“To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.
intro: Snugloo (Japanese: ユキボウ Yukibou) is an Ice element Pal.

title: Solenne
partner_skill_desc: While in the party, increases the player's Attack in party of different Pal species.
flavor: |Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.
intro: Solenne (Japanese: モノクローナ Monochrona) is a Dark / Neutral-element Pal.

title: Solmora
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.
intro: Solmora (Japanese: オーマンボ Ōmanbo) is a Water element Pal.

title: Solmora Lux
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5%. While in party, Makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.
intro: Solmora Lux (Japanese:トノサマンボ Tonosamanbo) is the Water / Electric-element subspecies of Solmora.

title: Sootseer
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to the ranch.
flavor: |It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.
intro: Sootseer (Japanese: オドロクロ Odorokuro) is a Dark / Fire-element Pal. Sootseer is a medium-sized, ghostly Pal with a predominantly black body and wispy purple flames emanating from its hands and head. It also has glowing green eyes and wears a skull-like mask on its face.

title: Souffline
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.
intro: Souffline (Japanese: ポポフィア Popofia) is a Grass element Pal.

title: Sparkit
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack of Electric Pals by . (Does not stack.) Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.
intro: Sparkit (Japanese: ボルトラ Boltora) is an Electric element Pal. Sparkit is a small bipedal cat-like Pal. Its body is mainly yellow with a large white tuft of fur on its upper chest. Its ears have two black bands around them. It has a black lightning bolt pattern across its head. The tail ends in a lightning bolt shape.

title: Splatterina
partner_skill_desc: While in possession, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases.
flavor: |It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.
intro: Splatterina (Japanese: ヤンデリナ Yanderīna) is a Dark-element Pal. Splatterina is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with a predominantly dark grey body wearing what appears to be a black dress. It also has wavy crimson hair divided into six segments that end in diamond-shaped bangs, two large black horns on its head, and a smaller, diamond-shaped black protrusion on its forehead. Additionally, Splatterina carries a large, curved cleaver in its right hand.

title: Starryon
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Increases movement speed while mounted at night.
flavor: |It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.
intro: Starryon (Japanese: ナイトロット Nightrot) is a Dark-element Pal. Starryon is an equine pal with a predominantly black body, a blue mane and tail, blue hooves, blue patches on its legs, and a white stripe on its face. It also has black chrome stripes at the base of its neck, on its back, and on its chest. Starryon also has a curved chrome horn on its head with crescent-shaped notches cut into it.

title: Starryon Primo
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by (5~25)% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)
flavor: |It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.
intro: Starryon Primo is a Neutral -element Pal. It is a subspecies of Starryon.

title: Surfent
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |Its hydrodynamic form is well suited to life in water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
intro: Surfent (Japanese: シーペント Seapent) is a Water-element Pal. Surfent is a medium-sized, serpentine Pal with a predominantly light blue body with a cream-colored face and underbelly. It also has two horn-like protrusions on its head, two pairs of flippers on its sides, and six orange fin-like protrusions on its back. Surfent also has a Ground-element subspecies, Surfent Terra.

title: Surfent Terra
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in team, Surfent Terra helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of ores in the player's inventory.
flavor: |Its aerodynamic form is well suited to life on the sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
intro: Surfent Terra (Japanese: スナペント Sunapent) is the Ground-element subspecies of Surfent. Surfent Terra is largely identical to the regular Surfent, save for the fact that it has a predominantly grey body with a golden metallic crystal protruding from its forehead and six smaller metallic crystals in place of the fins on its back.

title: Suzaku
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.
flavor: |It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.
