intro: Suzaku (Japanese: スザク Suzaku) is a Fire-element pal. Suzaku is a large, vaguely avian Pal with a red body, dark red stripes on its tail, neck, and wings, and yellow geometric markings on its head, back, tail, and wings. Suzaku also has a Water-element subspecies, Suzaku Aqua.

title: Suzaku Aqua
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Water attacks while mounted.
flavor: |It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. If there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.
intro: Suzaku Aqua (Japanese: シヴァ Shiva) is the Water-element subspecies of Suzaku. Suzaku Aqua is largely identical to the regular Suzaku, though it has a dark blue body, light blue tips on its wings and tail, and a blue gemstone in its forehead.

title: Swee
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa.
flavor: |Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!
intro: Swee (Japanese: コモップ Komop) is an Ice-element Pal. Swee is a small, round Pal mostly covered in fluffy white fur with a white tail, blue ears, and two small black dots for eyes.

title: Sweepa
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by for each Swee in party.
flavor: |While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.
intro: Sweepa (Japanese: ドンモップ Donmop) is an Ice-element Pal. Sweepa is a large Pal that greatly resembles Swee. Its round body is mostly covered in fluffy white fur with a white tail, blue ears, two small black dots for eyes, and a bushy white mustache under its eyes.

title: Tanzee
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.
flavor: |Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.
intro: Tanzee (Japanese: エテッパ Eteppa) is a Grass-element Pal. Tanzee is a small, monkey-like Pal with a predominantly green body and a tan face, belly, hands, and feet. It also has a dark-green, leaf-shaped crest on its forehead as well as a two smaller leaves on its upper chest and the tip of its tail respectively.

title: Tanzee Ignis
partner_skill_desc: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.
flavor: |Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.
intro: Tanzee Ignis (Japanese: カレッパ Kareppa) is a Fire element Pal. Tanzee Ignis is largely identical to the regular Tanzee, save for it having a predominantly yellow body and orange leaves.

title: Tarantriss
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider silk to grapple and move at fast speed.
flavor: |Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its "personality."
intro: Tarantriss (Japanese: モモンチュラ Momontula) is a Dark-element Pal. Tarantriss is a small, arachnid-like Pal with a predominantly black body supported by four legs with sharp black claws and layered in bright pink, skirt-like coverings. A frilled pink collar surrounds its white torso, which features yellow, eye-like markings on its chest. Two sleek arms extend from its shoulders, ending in oval, pod-like tufts of pink fur with purple stripes and three small, black, pointed fingers. Its head is large, with pink, moth-like antennae marked by a purple zigzag pattern. It also has narrow, catlike yellow

title: Teafant
partner_skill_desc: While in party, restores of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)
flavor: |Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.
intro: Teafant (Japanese: チョロゾウ Chorozō) is a Water-element Pal. Teafant is a small, elephant-like Pal with a round body shape, predominantly cream coloration, and light blue highlights on its ears, head, and the tip of its tail. It also has a small trunk that points upwards.

title: Tetroise
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.
intro: Tetroise (Japanese: オモシガメ Omoshigame) is a Ground element Pal.

title: Tetroise Primo
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces durability loss of all weapons and armor by (80~100)%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.
intro: Tetroise Primo (Japanese: オシロガメ Oshirogame) is a Neutral-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Tetroise.

title: Tocotoco
partner_skill_desc: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.
flavor: |A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.
intro: Tocotoco (Japanese: クルットリ Kuruttori) is a Neutral-element Pal. Tocotoco is a small, avian Pal that looks like a cross between a dodo and a toucan. Its body is predominantly green and black with orange highlights on its neck, yellow and orange highlights on its chest, and orange highlights on its wings. Tocotoco also has a yellow-and-red tail as well as a large, yellow-and-red mohawk on its head.

title: Tombat
partner_skill_desc: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap.
flavor: |Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.
intro: Tombat (Japanese: ニャンバット Nyanbat) is a Dark-element Pal. Tombat is a medium-sized, bipedal Pal that looks like a cross between a cat and a bat. It has a predominantly black body with white fur on its hands, face and chest as well as bright red fur under its chin. Tombat also has dark purple wings with yellow diamond patterns, two small purple flames floating on either side of its head, and another purple flame on the tip of its tail.

title: Tropicaw
partner_skill_desc: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps. (Does not stack)
flavor: |While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.
intro: Tropicaw (Japanese: フラペック Furapeck) is a Grass element Pal.

title: Turtacle
partner_skill_desc: While in party, reduces weight of the item Ore by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.
intro: Turtacle (Japanese: ヘルメッコ Helmekko) is a Water-element Pal. Turtacle is a small Pal with a cream colored body, stubby feet, and a tail with a pink tip. Attached to its head is a large, white-rimmed blue shell with red spikes. Turtacle also has two large arms coming from the underside of its shell that end in three-clawed hands. Turtacle also has a Water / Ground subspecies, Turtacle Terra.

title: Turtacle Terra
partner_skill_desc: While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal by . Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Ground attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.
intro: Turtacle Terra (Japanese: ゴルメッコ Golmekko) is the Water / Ground-element subspecies of Turtacle. Turtacle Terra is largely identical to the regular Turtacle, save for the fact that it has a golden shell.

title: Univolt
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals' Electric attacks when hitting the enemy's elemental weakness by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.
intro: Univolt (Japanese: ライコーン Raikorn) is an Electric-element Pal. Univolt is medium-sized, equine Pal with predominantly teal body and yellow thunderbolt patterns all along its head and back. It also has yellow markings on its chest and ankles as well as a jagged black horn on its head. Univolt also has an Ice-element subspecies, Univolt Cryst.

title: Univolt Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack type to Ice and increases Attack by .
flavor: |It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.
intro: Univolt Cryst is an Ice-element Pal. It is a subspecies of Univolt. Univolt Cryst is medium-sized, equine Pal with predominantly white body and icy-blue thunderbolt patterns all along its head and back. It also has icy-blue markings on its chest and ankles as well as a jagged icy-blue horn on its head.

title: Vaelet
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, Ground Pals drop more items when defeated.
flavor: |The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, "The King's Flower."
intro: Vaelet (Japanese: ヴィオレッタ Violetta) is a Grass element Pal. Vaelet is a small, humanoid Pal with a fairy-like appearance. It has a black body, white fur on its chest and neck, and six purple wings with the appearance of flower petals. Vaelet also wears a pointed green hat made of leaves as well as green armguards also made of leaves.

title: Valentail
partner_skill_desc: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling.(Does not stack)
flavor: |In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.
intro: Valentail (Japanese: ニャルル Nyaruru) is a Neutral element Pal.

title: Vanwyrm
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.
intro: Vanwyrm (Japanese: カバネドリ Kabanedori) is a Fire / Dark-element Pal. Vanwyrm is an avian Pal with a predominantly black body and red highlights on its wings, chest, and tail. Its head is grey and has four horns on it and it has a row of grey spikes on its back flanked by smaller black spikes. Vanwyrm also has an Ice / Dark-element subspecies, Vanwyrm Cryst.

title: Vanwyrm Cryst
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The melodies of a flute made from an exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountains ranges. In ages past, such flutes where used to signal victory in battle.
intro: Vanwyrm Cryst (Japanese: シロカバネ Shirokabane) is the Ice / Dark-element subspecies of Vanwyrm. Vanwyrm Cryst is largely identical to the regular Vanwyrm, except for the fact that it has a predominantly bluish-white body with darker blue legs and yellow feet. It also has icy highlights on its head, wings, chest, and tail as well as icy spikes on its back.

title: Venusa
partner_skill_desc: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Blind. (Does not stack)
flavor: |Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.
intro: Venusa (Japanese: メドゥーナ Meduna) is a Dark-element Pal.

title: Verdash
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, increases player's movement speed and changes the player's attack type to Grass.
flavor: |Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing there soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.
intro: Verdash (Japanese: ラベロット Raberotto) is a Grass element Pal. Verdash is a medium-sized, humanoid Pal with rabbit-like features. It has an olive-green body with long, pointy ears, darker-green spiky hair and a "collar" of green fur with yellow highlights around its neck. It wears what appears to be a pair of green shorts with yellow highlights and an orange waistband. It also has a large, bushy green tail.

title: Vixy
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.
flavor: |The idol of Palpagos Islands. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.
intro: Vixy (Japanese: タマモ Tamamo) is a Neutral-element Pal. Vixy is a small, fox-like Pal with a predominantly sandy blonde body, a white face and feet, and yellow highlights on its ears and hair. It also has a collar of fluffy, cream-colored fur around its neck.

title: Warsect
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.
flavor: |The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.
intro: Warsect (Japanese: グラクレス Guracres) is a Ground / Grass-element Pal. Warsect is a large, bipedal insectoid Pal with a beetle-like appearance. Its body is primarily black with yellow highlights and it possesses multiple horns on its head, with two larger ones on the sides and two smaller ones on the front and back of its head. Warsect also has a pure Ground-element subspecies, Warsect Terra.

title: Warsect Terra
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.
flavor: |The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.
intro: Warsect Terra (Japanese: ゴルクレス Golcres) is the pure Ground-element subspecies of Warsect. Warsect Terra is largely identical to the regular Warsect, though most of its body is covered in a lustrous golden sheen.

title: Whalaska
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, the fishing minigame starts with the capture gauge higher than usual. Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster when the bar is aligned.
flavor: |When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.
intro: Whalaska (Japanese: コゴエール Kogoale) is an Ice / Water-element Pal. Whalaska is a large, whale-like Pal with a light blue upper body, a white lower body, four pectoral fins, and a white goatee on its chin. Its back is covered in bluish ice and it has a large icy horn on its forehead. Whalaska also has an Ice / Fire-element subspecies, Whalaska Ignis.

title: Whalaska Ignis
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, the fishing minigame starts with the capture gauge higher than usual. Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster when the bar is aligned.
flavor: |Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.
intro: Whalaska Ignis (Japanese:モモエール Momoale) is the Ice / Fire-element subspecies of Whalaska. Whalaska Ignis is largely identical to the regular Whalaska, save for it having a pink upper body and reddish-pink ice on its back.

title: Wispaw
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus. (Does not stack)
flavor: |The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.
intro: Wispaw (Japanese: ニャンシー Nyanshee) is a Dark element Pal. Whispaw is a small, feline Pal with a chibi design, having a large head, large yellow eyes, and a small frown. Its arms resemble oversized sleeves, and it has a purple crescent moon on its forehead and a purple scarf. Two large, spectral hands protrude from its back, which it uses to interact with things.

title: Wistella
partner_skill_desc: While in party, increases Defense of Dark Pals by (15~30)%. (Does not stack)
flavor: |At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.
intro: Wistella (Japanese: ホシノコ Hoshinoko) is a Dark element Pal.

title: Wixen
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Fire.
flavor: |With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. it prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.
intro: Wixen (Japanese: フォレーナ Forena) is a Fire element Pal. Wixen is a humanoid, fox-like Pal with white fur wearing a red robe with an orange interior. It also wears a red, wide-brimmed witch's hat with an orange flame on top. Wixen also has a Fire / Dark-element subspecies, Wixen Noct.

title: Wixen Noct
partner_skill_desc: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Dark.
flavor: |Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.
intro: Wixen Noct (Japanese: フォレーオ Forēo) is the Fire / Dark-element subspecies of Wixen. Wixen Noct is largely identical to the regular Wixen, albeit with a color scheme resembling Katress.

title: Woolipop
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.
intro: Woolipop (Japanese: メリポップ Meripop) is a Neutral-element Pal. Woolipop is a medium-sized, sheep-like Pal with a tan body mostly covered in fluffy bright-pink wool. It also has a pair of curled, peach-colored horns.

title: Woolipop Terra
partner_skill_desc: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.
intro: Woolipop Terra (Japanese: メリコロネ Merikorone) is a Ground element Pal.

title: Wumpo
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.
flavor: |Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.
intro: Wumpo (Japanese: ヒエティ Hieti) is an Ice-element Pal. Wumpo is a large, bipedal Pal with a rotund body covered in white and light-blue fur. It has a small opening in the fur that reveals its eyes and it carries a small sprig in its mouth. Wumpo also has a Grass-element subspecies, Wumpo Botan.

title: Wumpo Botan
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo Botan helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.
flavor: |Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.
intro: Wumpo Botan (Japanese: トロピティ Tropiti) is the Grass-element subspecies of Wumpo. Wumpo Botan is largely identical to the regular Wumpo, albeit with a green color scheme and an orange flower on the right side of its head.

title: Xenogard
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player's energy weapon damage by 10% . (Does not stack)
flavor: |Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.
intro: Xenogard (Japanese: ゼノルーダ Xenoruder) is a Dragon element Pal. Xenogard is a quadupedal, draconic Pal with a predominantly black body covered in pale grey armored plates. It also has long, horn-like protrusions on its head and a fan-like tail with five large crystals.

title: Xenolord
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by 20%. (Does not stack
flavor: | -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!
intro: Xenolord (Japanese: ゼノドラン Xenodran) is a Dark / Dragon element Pal. Xenolord is a large, bipedal draconic Pal with a predominantly dark grey body and a bronze-colored belly. It has cobalt blue armored plates on its chest and head as well as four large, light blue diamonds made of energy floating behind its back that resemble wings.

title: Xenovader
partner_skill_desc: While in the team, increases damage dealt to ores, and it's easier to obtain Meteorite Fragment.
flavor: |Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.
intro: Xenovader (Japanese: ゼノベーダ Xenovader) is a Dark-element Pal. Xenovader is a bipdeal, humanoid Pal with a reptilian appearance. It has a predominantly black body with a grey chest and waist as well as purple markings on its arms, legs, head, and tail. Xenovader also has large claws as well as two sideways-facing purple horns near its jaw.

title: Yakumo
partner_skill_desc: Can be ridden. While fighting together, it becomes easier to encounter pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)
flavor: |It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.
intro: Yakumo (Japanese: ヤクモマル Yakumomaru) is a Neutral element Pal. Yakumo is a small, canine Pal with a predominantly grey body with dark blue highlights. It also has red bands and cloud-like protrusions on its ankles as well as a small golden horn on its forehead.
